original: avaśyaṃ tasminnimittamupādatte yathā kaścinmanyate śvo mama gṛhe brāhmaṇā bhoktāraḥ | ato'dya payo gṛhṇāmīti | yadi payasi dadhi na syāt‌ | kuto na jalaṃ gṛhṇāti | kāryārthinā upādānagrahaṇājjñāyate pradhāne mahānastīti | sarvasaṃbhavāditi | yadi kāraṇe kāryaṃ nāsti | tadā sarvaṃ sarvamutpādayet‌ |
analyzed: avaśyam tasmin nimittam upādatte yathā kaścid manyate śvas mama gṛhe brāhmaṇāḥ bhoktāraḥ atas udya payaḥ gṛhṇāmi iti yadi payasi dadhi na syāt kutas na jalam gṛhṇāti kārya arthinā upādāna grahaṇāt jñāyate pradhāne mahān asti iti sarva saṃbhavāt iti yadi kāraṇe kāryam na asti tadā sarvam sarvam utpādayet

original: tṛṇapāṣaṇavālukādīni suvarṇarajatādīnyutpādayeyuḥ | etatkāryāsaṃbhavājjñāyate hetau kāryamastīti | śaktasya śakyakaraṇāditi | yathā kulālaḥ sajjopakaraṇo mṛtpiṇḍāt‌ [śakyaṃ] ghaṭaśarāvādi racayati | na tu tṛṇavṛkṣādibhyo ghaṭaṃ śarāvaṃ vā | iti pradhānaṃ śaktaḥ karoti mahadādi | ataḥ pradhāne mahadādyastīti jñāyate |
analyzed: tṛṇa pāṣaṇa vālukā ādīni suvarṇa rajata ādīni utpādayeyuḥ etat kārya asaṃbhavāt jñāyate hetau kāryam asti iti śaktasya śakya karaṇāt iti yathā kulālaḥ sajja upakaraṇaḥ mṛd piṇḍāt śakyam ghaṭa śarāva ādi racayati na tu tṛṇa vṛkṣa ādibhyaḥ ghaṭam śarāvam vā iti pradhānam śaktaḥ karoti mahat ādi atas pradhāne mahat ādi asti iti jñāyate

original: kāraṇamanusṛtya kāryabhāvāditi | yajjātīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryamapi evaṃjātīyakam‌ | yathā yavāṅkuro'vaśyaṃ yavajātimanusarati | yadyasatkāryam‌ | tadāvaśyaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇavirūpaṃ syāt‌ | tathā sati yavānmāṣādyaṅkuraḥ siddhyet‌ | evamasaṃbhavājjñāyate satkāryam‌ | vaiśeṣikādayo vadanti kāraṇe kāryaṃ nāstīti | etanna yujyate |
analyzed: kāraṇam anusṛtya kārya bhāvāt iti yad jātīyam kāraṇam kāryam api evaṃjātīyakam yathā yava aṅkuraḥ uvaśyam yava jātim anusarati yadi asatkāryam tadā avaśyam kāryam kāraṇa virūpam syāt tathā sati yavāt māṣa ādi aṅkuraḥ siddhyet evam asaṃbhavāt jñāyate satkāryam vaiśeṣika ādayaḥ vadanti kāraṇe kāryam na asti iti etat na yujyate

original: ato jñāyate kāraṇe kāryaṃ niyatamiti || 9 ||
analyzed: atas jñāyate kāraṇe kāryam niyatam iti

original: antarāpraśnaṃ parisamāpya pūrvoktārthaḥ punaḥ prastūyate prakṛtivirūpamiti | vairūpyaṃ navavidham‌ |
analyzed: antarāpraśnam parisamāpya pūrva ukta arthaḥ punar prastūyate prakṛti virūpam iti vairūpyam navavidham

original: hetumadanityamavyāpi sakriyamanekamāśritaṃ liṅgam‌ |
analyzed: hetumat anityam avyāpi sa kriyam anekam āśritam liṅgam

original: sāvayavaṃ paratantraṃ vyaktaṃ viparītamavyaktam‌ || 10 ||
analyzed: sa avayavam paratantram vyaktam viparītam avyaktam

original: hetumaditi | mahadādi pañcabhūtaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ hetumat‌ | [tathā hi] pradhānaṃ mahato hetuḥ | mahānahaṅkārasya hetuḥ | ahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇāṃ hetuḥ | pañcatanmātrāṇi indriyādiṣoḍaśatattvānāṃ hetavaḥ | pradhānantu na tathā | hetuto'nutpannatvāt‌ | ata uktaṃ virūpamiti | anityamiti | mahadādi pradhānādutpannam‌ | utpannatvād‌ idamanityam‌ |
analyzed: hetumat iti mahat ādi pañcabhūta paryantam sarvam hetumat tathā hi pradhānam mahataḥ hetuḥ mahān ahaṅkārasya hetuḥ ahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇām hetuḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi indriya ādi ṣoḍaśa tattvānām hetavaḥ pradhānam tu na tathā hetutaḥ nutpanna tvāt atas uktam virūpam iti anityam iti mahat ādi pradhānāt utpannam utpanna tvāt idam anityam

original: anityaṃ dvividham‌ acirakālāvasthāyyanityaṃ kṣaṇikānityamiti | yāvatparasparavirodhipratyayo nāgataḥ tāvatkālaṃ [vidyamānaṃ] acirakālāvasthāyi yathā parvatāraṇyādi, agnibhaye'nāgate sati tadalpakālaṃ tiṣṭhati agnibhaye āgate tu pañcamahābhūtādi pañcatanmātreṣu līyate | pañcatanmātrāṇi ahaṅkāre līyante | ahaṅkāro mahati līyate |
analyzed: anityam dvividham acira kāla avasthāyi anityam kṣaṇika anityam iti yāvat paraspara virodhi pratyayaḥ nāgataḥ tāvatkālam vidyamānam acira kāla avasthāyi yathā parvata araṇya ādi agni bhayena āgate sati tat alpa kālam tiṣṭhati agni bhaye āgate tu pañca mahābhūta ādi pañca tanmātreṣu līyate pañca tanmātrāṇi ahaṅkāre līyante ahaṅkāraḥ mahati līyate

original: mahān‌ pradhāne līyate | ata idaṃ mahadādyanityam‌ | na tathā pradhānam‌ | nityatvādalīnatvācca | anekamiti | mahadādi anekam‌ | pratipuruṣaṃ vaiṣamyāt‌ | ahaṅkāro'pyevam‌ | pradhānantvekameva bahupuruṣeṣu sādhāraṇatvāt‌ | avyāpīti | pradhānapuruṣau sarvatra pṛthivyāmantarikṣe divi ca vyāpnutaḥ | mahadādi kāryantu na tathā | asarvagatatvāt‌ |
analyzed: mahān pradhāne līyate atas idam mahat ādi anityam na tathā pradhānam nitya tvāt alīna tvāt ca anekam iti mahat ādi anekam prati puruṣam vaiṣamyāt ahaṅkāraḥ upi evam pradhānantu ekam eva bahu puruṣeṣu sādhāraṇa tvāt avyāpi iti pradhāna puruṣau sarvatra pṛthivyām antarikṣe divi ca vyāpnutaḥ mahat ādi kāryam tu na tathā a sarvagata tvāt

original: tasmātprakṛtivibhinnam‌ | sakriyamiti | mahadādikāryaṃ saṃsāramutpipādayiṣuḥ trayodaśavidhakaraṇaiḥ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ saṃsārayati saṃsāre, vikāsayati saṃkocayati gamayati āgamayati ca | na tathā pradhānam‌ | saṃkocavikāsāsaṃbhavāt‌ | liṅgamiti | mahadādivikāraḥ pradhānaṃ prati nivṛttaścet‌ tadā nopalabhyate | idaṃ liṅgamākhyāyate |
analyzed: tasmāt prakṛti vibhinnam sa kriyam iti mahat ādi kāryam saṃsāram utpipādayiṣuḥ trayodaśavidha karaṇaiḥ sūkṣmaśarīram saṃsārayati saṃsāre vikāsayati saṃkocayati gamayati āgamayati ca na tathā pradhānam saṃkoca vikāsa asaṃbhavāt liṅgam iti mahat ādi vikāraḥ pradhānam prati nivṛttaḥ ced tadā na upalabhyate idam liṅgam ākhyāyate

original: yathā pañcamahābhūtādi pañcatanmātreṣu layaṃ prāpnoti | punarmahābhūtādi nopalabhāmahe | yāvanmahān‌ pradhāne līyate | mahānapi nopalabhyate | na tathā pradhānam‌ | layaprāptyabhāvāt‌ | sāvayavamiti | mahadādi sarvaṃ sāvayavam‌ | avayavānāṃ bhedāt‌ | na tathā pradhānamiti | nityatvād‌ avayavānāmabhāvācca | āśritamiti |
analyzed: yathā pañca mahābhūta ādi pañca tanmātreṣu layam prāpnoti punar mahābhūta ādi na upalabhāmahe yāvat mahān pradhāne līyate mahān api na upalabhyate na tathā pradhānam laya prāpti abhāvāt sa avayavam iti mahat ādi sarvam sa avayavam avayavānām bhedāt na tathā pradhānam iti nitya tvāt avayavānām abhāvāt ca āśritam iti

original: yan‌ mahān‌ pradhānamāśritaḥ | ahaṅkāro mahāntamāśritaḥ | pañcatanmātrāṇi ahaṅkāramāśritāni | pañcamahābhūtādiṣoḍaśakaḥ sarvaḥ pañcatanmātrāṇyāśritaḥ | na tathā pradhānam‌ | anyenānutpannatvāt‌ | paratantramiti | mahadādeḥ pradhānādutpannasya kāryasyāsvatantratvāt‌ | yathā pitari jīvati putro na svatantraḥ | na tathā pradhānam‌ |
analyzed: yat mahān pradhānam āśritaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ mahāntam āśritaḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi ahaṅkāram āśritāni pañca mahābhūta ādi ṣoḍaśakaḥ sarvaḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi āśritaḥ na tathā pradhānam anyena anutpanna tvāt paratantram iti mahat ādeḥ pradhānāt utpannasya kāryasya asvatantra tvāt yathā pitari jīvati putraḥ na svatantraḥ na tathā pradhānam

original: kāraṇasya paratantratvābhāvāt‌ | anena navavidhena kāraṇena vyaktāvyaktayorvaiṣamyād‌ virūpamityuktam‌ || 10 ||
analyzed: kāraṇasya paratantra tva abhāvāt anena navavidhena kāraṇena vyakta avyaktayoḥ vaiṣamyāt virūpam iti uktam

original: vairūpyamabhidhāya sārūpyamidānīmucyate | prakṛtisarūpamityāryayā pradarśayati |
analyzed: vairūpyam abhidhāya sārūpyam idānīm ucyate prakṛti sarūpam iti āryayā pradarśayati

original: triguṇamaviveki viṣayaḥ sāmānyamacetanaṃ prasavadharmi |
analyzed: triguṇam aviveki viṣayaḥ sāmānyam acetanam prasava dharmi

original: vyaktaṃ tathā pradhānaṃ tadviparītastathā ca pumān‌ || 11 ||
analyzed: vyaktam tathā pradhānam tad viparītaḥ tathā ca pumān

original: [evaṃ] pradhānaṃ vyaktañca sarūpam‌, pumān‌ sārūpyavairūpyaviparītaḥ ||
analyzed: evam pradhānam vyaktam ca sarūpam pumān sārūpya vairūpya viparītaḥ

original: sārūpyaṃ ṣaḍvidham‌ | [tatra] prathamaṃ triguṇamiti | vyaktaṃ triguṇam‌ | vyaktamiti yaduta mahānahaṅkāro yāvatpañcamahābhūtāni | etattrayodaśavidhaṃ sarvaṃ sattvarajastamorūpatriguṇam‌ | vyaktasya triguṇatvād‌ avyaktaṃ triguṇamiti jñāyate | kāryasya kāraṇāvyatiriktatvāt‌ | yathā kṛṣṇatantubhyaḥ kṛṣṇapaṭaḥ |
analyzed: sārūpyam ṣaḍvidham tatra prathamam triguṇam iti vyaktam triguṇam vyaktam iti yat uta mahān ahaṅkāraḥ yāvat pañca mahābhūtāni etat trayodaśavidham sarvam sattva rajaḥ tamaḥ rūpa triguṇam vyaktasya triguṇa tvāt avyaktam triguṇam iti jñāyate kāryasya kāraṇa a vyatirikta tvāt yathā kṛṣṇa tantubhyaḥ kṛṣṇa paṭaḥ

original: kāryakāraṇayoḥ sarūpatvād‍ vyaktaṃ triguṇaṃ jñāyate | vyaktasya ca pradhānakṛtatvāt‌ pradhānaṃ triguṇam‌ iti vyaktāvyaktayoḥ sārūpyamuktam‌ | avivekīti | vyaktaṃ guṇā iti vivektuṃ na pāryate | yathā gauraśvaśvānekātmakau | na tathā guṇā vyaktañca | pradhānaṃ trituṇamapyevaṃ samānamaviveki iti vyaktamavyaktañca sarūpam‌ | viṣaya ita i|
analyzed: kārya kāraṇayoḥ sarūpa tvāt vyaktam triguṇam jñāyate vyaktasya ca pradhāna kṛta tvāt pradhānam triguṇam iti vyakta avyaktayoḥ sārūpyam uktam aviveki iti vyaktam guṇāḥ iti vivektum na pāryate yathā gauḥ aśva śvā aneka ātmakau na tathā guṇāḥ vyaktam ca pradhānam trituṇam api evam samānam aviveki iti vyaktam avyaktam ca sarūpam viṣayaḥ itas iti

original: mahadādi vyaktaṃ puruṣasyopabhogyatvād‌ viṣaya ityucyate | pradhānamapi tathā | puruṣasyopabhogyatvāt‌ | sāmānyamiti | mahadādi vyaktaṃ sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ sādhāraṇopayogi | yathā ekasyā dāsyā bahavaḥ prabhavaḥ santi | [sarveṣāṃ] sādhāraṇyena niyojyatvāt‌ | tathā pradhānamapi sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ sādhāraṇopayogi | tasmāduktaṃ sarūpamiti | acetanamiti |
analyzed: mahat ādi vyaktam puruṣasya upabhogya tvāt viṣayaḥ iti ucyate pradhānam api tathā puruṣasya upabhogya tvāt sāmānyam iti mahat ādi vyaktam sarva puruṣāṇām sādhāraṇa upayogi yathā ekasyāḥ dāsyāḥ bahavaḥ prabhavaḥ santi sarveṣām sādhāraṇyena niyojya tvāt tathā pradhānam api sarva puruṣāṇām sādhāraṇa upayogi tasmāt uktam sarūpam iti acetanam iti

original: mahadādi vyaktaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohabhedānna vijānāti | jñānasya puruṣamātralabdhatvāt‌ | puruṣavyatiriktā dharmā acetanāḥ | tathā pradhānamapi | vyaktamavyaktañca samamacetanam‌ | tayorbhāvaḥ sarūpaḥ | prasavadharmi [evaṃ] pradhānaṃ vyaktañca sarūpamiti | mahānahaṅkāraṃ prasūte | ahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi prasūte | yāvatpañcamahābhūtāni |
analyzed: mahat ādi vyaktam sukha duḥkha moha bhedān na vijānāti jñānasya puruṣa mātra labdha tvāt puruṣa vyatiriktāḥ dharmāḥ acetanāḥ tathā pradhānam api vyaktam avyaktam ca samam acetanam tayoḥ bhāvaḥ sarūpaḥ prasava dharmi evam pradhānam vyaktam ca sarūpam iti mahān ahaṅkāram prasūte ahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi prasūte yāvat pañca mahābhūtāni

original: pradhānaṃ mahāntaṃ prasūte iti vyaktāvyaktayoḥ sārūpyam‌ | pumān‌ sārūpyavairūpyaviparīta iti | vyaktāvyaktayoḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ sārūpyamasti | puruṣasya naitatsārūpyamasti | tasmātsārūpyaviparītaḥ vairūpyaviparītaśceti | vyaktāvyaktayornavavidhaṃ vairūpya[mukta]m‌ | tatrāṣṭavidhaviparītaḥ pumān‌ | ta uktaṃ vairūpyaviparīta iti |
analyzed: pradhānam mahāntam prasūte iti vyakta avyaktayoḥ sārūpyam pumān sārūpya vairūpya viparītaḥ iti vyakta avyaktayoḥ ṣaḍvidham sārūpyam asti puruṣasya na etat sārūpyam asti tasmāt sārūpya viparītaḥ vairūpya viparītaḥ ca iti vyakta avyaktayoḥ navavidham vairūpyam uktam tatra aṣṭavidha viparītaḥ pumān te uktam vairūpya viparītaḥ iti

original: puruṣāṇāmanekatvānna pradhānasārūpyam‌ || 11 ||
analyzed: puruṣāṇām aneka tvāt na pradhāna sārūpyam

original: para āha | vyaktamavyaktañca triguṇamuktam‌ | ime trayo guṇāḥ kimātmakāḥ | āryayā uttarayati |
analyzed: paraḥ āha vyaktam avyaktam ca triguṇam uktam ime trayaḥ guṇāḥ kimātmakāḥ āryayā uttarayati

original: prītyaprītiviṣādātmakāḥ prakāśapravṛttiniyamārthāḥ |
analyzed: prīti aprīti viṣāda ātmakāḥ prakāśa pravṛtti niyama arthāḥ

original: anyonyābhibhavāśrayajananamithunavṛttayaśca guṇāḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: anyonya abhibhava āśraya janana mithuna vṛttayaḥ ca guṇāḥ 12

original: prītyaprītiviṣādātmakā iti | sattvaṃ rajastama itīme trayo guṇāḥ | prītiḥ sattvasyātmā | rajaso'prītirātmā | tamaso viṣāda ātmā | iti trayaḥ svabhāvā dṛśyante | prakāśapravṛttiniyamārthā iti | kiṃ kurvanti ime trayo guṇāḥ | ādyaḥ prakāśaṃ prabhāṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ | madhyamastu jananaṃ pravṛttiṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ |
analyzed: prīti aprīti viṣāda ātmakāḥ iti sattvam rajaḥ tamaḥ iti ime trayaḥ guṇāḥ prītiḥ sattvasya ātmā rajasaḥ prītiḥ ātmā tamasaḥ viṣādaḥ ātmā iti trayaḥ svabhāvāḥ dṛśyante prakāśa pravṛtti niyama arthāḥ iti kim kurvanti ime trayaḥ guṇāḥ ādyaḥ prakāśam prabhām kartum samarthaḥ madhyamaḥ tu jananam pravṛttim kartum samarthaḥ

original: antimaḥ niyamaṃ bandhaṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ | idaṃ triguṇānvayaṃ kāryam‌ | anyonyābhibhavāśrayajananamithunavṛttayaśca triguṇadharmā iti | ke dharmāstriguṇasya | teṣāṃ dharmāḥ pañcavidhāḥ | anyonyābhibhaveti | sattvamutkaṭañced‌ rajastamasī abhibhavati | yathā mahān‌ sūryaraśmiścandranakṣatrādīnabhibhavati |
analyzed: antimaḥ niyamam bandham kartum samarthaḥ idam triguṇa anvayam kāryam anyonya abhibhava āśraya janana mithuna vṛttayaḥ ca triguṇa dharmāḥ iti ke dharmāḥ triguṇasya teṣām dharmāḥ pañcavidhāḥ anyonya abhibhava iti sattvam utkaṭam ced rajaḥ tamasī abhibhavati yathā mahān sūrya raśmiḥ candra nakṣatra ādīn abhibhavati

original: raja utkaṭañcet‌ sattvatamasī abhibhavati | yathā prakāśamānaḥ sūryaraśmiḥ nakṣatrāṇi candrañcābhibhavati | tama utkaṭañced‌ rajassattve abhibhavati | yathā sūryasya mahatā prakāśena nakṣatrāṇāṃ candrasya ca prakāśo na dṛśyate | anyonyāśrayeti | ime guṇāḥ parasparāśrayāḥ sarvakāryakaraṇasamarthāḥ |
analyzed: rajaḥ utkaṭam ced sattva tamasī abhibhavati yathā prakāśamānaḥ sūrya raśmiḥ nakṣatrāṇi candram ca abhibhavati tamaḥ utkaṭam ced rajaḥ sattve abhibhavati yathā sūryasya mahatā prakāśena nakṣatrāṇām candrasya ca prakāśaḥ na dṛśyate anyonya āśraya iti ime guṇāḥ paraspara āśrayāḥ sarva kārya karaṇa samarthāḥ

original: yathā tridaṇḍī parasparāśrayā kuṇḍikādīnavaṣṭabhnāti | anyonyajananeti | kadācitsattvaṃ rajastamasī janayati | kadācid‌ rajassattvatamasī janayati | kadācittamo rajassattve janayati | yathā trayaḥ puruṣāḥ parasparamāśrayanyo yugapadekamarthaṃ kurvanti | tathā mahadādisthā guṇāḥ parasparamāśrayantaḥ saṃhatya jananamaraṇe kurvanti |
analyzed: yathā tridaṇḍī paraspara āśrayā kuṇḍika ādīn avaṣṭabhnāti anyonya jananā iti kadācid sattvam rajaḥ tamasī janayati kadācid rajaḥ sattva tamasī janayati kadācid tamaḥ rajaḥ sattve janayati yathā trayaḥ puruṣāḥ parasparam āśrayan yaḥ yugapad ekam artham kurvanti tathā mahat ādi sthāḥ guṇāḥ parasparam āśrayantaḥ saṃhatya janana maraṇe kurvanti

original: anyonyamithuneti | sattvaṃ kadācidrajasā mithunaṃ, kadācit‌ tamasā mithunam‌ | rajaḥ kadācitsattvena mithunaṃ, kadācit‌ tamasā mithunam‌ | evaṃ tamo'pi kadācitsattvena mithunaṃ, kadācidrajasā mithunam‌ | yathoktā gāthā vyāsamaharṣiṇā |
analyzed: anyonya mithuna iti sattvam kadācid rajasā mithunam kadācid tamasā mithunam rajaḥ kadācid sattvena mithunam kadācid tamasā mithunam evam tamaḥ api kadācid sattvena mithunam kadācid rajasā mithunam yathā uktāḥ gāthāḥ vyāsa mahā ṛṣiṇā

original: rajaso mithunaṃ sattvaṃ sattvasya mithunaṃ rajaḥ |
analyzed: rajasaḥ mithunam sattvam sattvasya mithunam rajaḥ

original: ubhayoḥ sattvarajasormithunaṃ tama ucyate || iti |
analyzed: ubhayoḥ sattva rajasoḥ mithunam tamaḥ ucyate iti

original: anyonyavṛttīti | ime trayo guṇāḥ anyonyamarthaṃ kurvanti | yathā rājakulastrī supriyarūpaśīlā | ayaṃ sattvaguṇa ucyate | etatsattvapariṇataṃ rūpaṃ bharturbandhośca prītiṃ karoti | idaṃ svārthakaraṇamucyate | [saiva] sarvāsāṃ sapatnīnāṃ śokaṃ janayati | idamanyārthakaraṇamucyate | anyeṣāṃ viṣādamapi janayati |
analyzed: anyonya vṛtti iti ime trayaḥ guṇāḥ anyonyam artham kurvanti yathā rāja kula strī su priya rūpa śīlā ayam sattva guṇaḥ ucyate etat sattva pariṇatam rūpam bhartuḥ bandhoḥ ca prītim karoti idam svārtha karaṇam ucyate sā eva sarvāsām sapatnīnām śokam janayati idam anya artha karaṇam ucyate anyeṣām viṣādam api janayati

original: yathā dāsyādayaḥ sadā tatparicaryākhinnā mocanamalabhamānā viṣādāviṣṭacittā bhavanti | idamucyate anyārthajananam‌ | idameva sattvaguṇasya svaparārthakaraṇamucyate | rajaḥ svaparārthaṃ janayati | yathā kaściccoro rājakulastriyaṃ badhnāti | tadā rājavaṃśyo'śvārūḍho daṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā āgamya paritrāyate | rājavaṃśyo rajaḥpariṇataḥ |
analyzed: yathā dāsī ādayaḥ sadā tad paricaryā khinnāḥ mocanam alabhamānāḥ viṣāda āviṣṭa cittāḥ bhavanti idam ucyate anya artha jananam idam eva sattva guṇasya sva para artha karaṇam ucyate rajaḥ sva para artham janayati yathā kaścid coraḥ rāja kula striyam badhnāti tadā rāja vaṃśya ūśva ārūḍhaḥ daṇḍam gṛhītvā āgamya paritrāyate rāja vaṃśyaḥ rajaḥ pariṇataḥ

original: rājavaṃśyo bhayagocaro'pi striyaḥ ahaṃ mocanaṃ lapsye ityānandaṃ janayati | idamanyārthajananam‌ | anye corā rājadarśanāt‌ sthāṇuvanna calanti | idamucyate'nyeṣāṃ mohajananam‌ | rajaḥ svaparārthaṃ janayatītyuktam‌ | tamaḥ svaparārthaṃ janayati | yathā mahān‌ ghanaḥ kṛṣṇameghaḥ vidyudādīnārabhate | meghastamaḥpariṇataḥ |
analyzed: rāja vaṃśyaḥ bhaya gocaraḥ api striyaḥ aham mocanam lapsye iti ānandam janayati idam anya artha jananam anye corāḥ rāja darśanāt sthāṇu vat na calanti idam ucyate nyeṣām moha jananam rajaḥ sva para artham janayati iti uktam tamaḥ sva para artham janayati yathā mahān ghanaḥ kṛṣṇa meghaḥ vidyut ādīn ārabhate meghaḥ tamaḥ pariṇataḥ

original: sarve kṛṣīvalā dhānyopajīvino modante | idamucyate'nyārthajananam‌ | mohamapi janayati | yathā kācidyuvatiḥ bhartṛviyuktā imaṃ meghaṃ vidyutañca dṛṣṭvā khidyate bhartā na pratinivṛtta iti | striyo mohaṃ janayati [megha] itīdamucyate svārthajananam‌ | śokamapi janayati |
analyzed: sarve kṛṣīvalāḥ dhānya upajīvinaḥ modante idam ucyate nyārtha jananam moham api janayati yathā kācid yuvatiḥ bhartṛ viyuktā imam megham vidyutam ca dṛṣṭvā khidyate bhartā na pratinivṛttaḥ iti striyaḥ moham janayati meghaḥ iti idam ucyate svārtha jananam śokam api janayati

original: yathā vaṇijaḥ pathi vartamānāḥ saṃklinnā bhāravahanāsamarthā khinnahṛdayā bhavanti | idamucyate'nyārthajananam‌ | evaṃ pañcavidhāstriguṇānvayā dharmāḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: yathā vaṇijaḥ pathi vartamānāḥ saṃklinnāḥ bhāra vahana asamarthā khinna hṛdayāḥ bhavanti evam pañcavidhāḥ triguṇa anvayāḥ dharmāḥ

original: kiñcāsti guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇam‌ |
analyzed: kiñca asti guṇānām lakṣaṇam

original: sattvaṃ laghu prakāśakamiṣṭamupaṣṭambhakaṃ calañca rajaḥ |
analyzed: sattvam laghu prakāśakam iṣṭam upaṣṭambhakam calam ca rajaḥ

original: guru varaṇakameva tamaḥ pradīpavaccārthato vṛttiḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: guru varaṇakam eva tamaḥ pradīpa vat ca arthataḥ vṛttiḥ

original: sattvaṃ laghuprakāśakalakṣaṇamiṣṭamiti | laghu sūkṣmam‌ | prakāśakaṃ pradīpakam‌ | tat‌ sattvamākhyātam‌ | sattvamutkaṭañcet‌ sarvāṇīndriyāṇi laghūni mṛdūni viṣayagrahaṇasamarthāni bhavanti | tadā mantavyaṃ sattvamutkaṭamiti | raja upaṣṭambhakacalalakṣaṇamiṣṭamiti | upaṣṭambhakamunmanaḥ anyāvigaṇayitṛ |
analyzed: sattvam laghu prakāśaka lakṣaṇam iṣṭam iti laghu sūkṣmam prakāśakam pradīpakam tat sattvam ākhyātam sattvam utkaṭam ced sarvāṇi indriyāṇi laghūni mṛdūni viṣaya grahaṇa samarthāni bhavanti tadā mantavyam sattvam utkaṭam iti rajaḥ upaṣṭambhaka cala lakṣaṇam iṣṭam iti upaṣṭambhakam unmanaḥ anya a vigaṇayitṛ

original: yathā mattagajaḥ kalahaḥ mṛgayamāṇaḥ dviṣantaṃ gajamāgataṃ sthagayate | raja utkaṭañcet‌ tadā manuṣyaḥ sadā kalahaṃ mṛgayate | sadā calacitta ekatrāvasthānāsamarthaśca bhavati | tadā mantavyaṃ rajoguṇa utkaṭa iti | tamo guruvaraṇakalakṣaṇamiti | tamoguṇo yadyutkaṭaḥ, [tadā] sarvaśarīraṃ guru | indriyāṇi [tamo]vṛtatvād‌ viṣayagrahaṇāsamarthāni |
analyzed: yathā matta gajaḥ kalahaḥ mṛgayamāṇaḥ dviṣantam gajam āgatam sthagayate rajaḥ utkaṭam ced tadā manuṣyaḥ sadā kalaham mṛgayate sadā cala cittaḥ ekatra avasthāna asamarthaḥ ca bhavati tadā mantavyam rajaḥ guṇaḥ utkaṭaḥ iti tamaḥ guru varaṇaka lakṣaṇam iti tamaḥ guṇaḥ yadi utkaṭaḥ tadā sarva śarīram guru indriyāṇi tamaḥ vṛta tvāt viṣaya grahaṇa asamarthāni

original: tadā mantavyaṃ tamo guṇa utkaṭa vartate | para āha | yadi guṇāḥ parasparaviruddhāḥ | [tathāpi] ekapuruṣatantrasyāsvatantratvād‌ yugapadekāṃ vṛttiṃ labhante | yathā pradīpārthaṃ mitho viruddhānāṃ saṃyogaḥ | pradīpārthaṃ hi trayaḥ padārthā [mitho viruddhā api] saṃyujyante | tailavartikayorviruddhaḥ agniḥ | tailamapi agnivartikayorviruddham‌ |
analyzed: tadā mantavyam tamaḥ guṇaḥ utkaṭa vartate paraḥ āha yadi guṇāḥ paraspara viruddhāḥ tathā api eka puruṣa tantrasya asvatantra tvāt yugapad ekām vṛttim labhante yathā pradīpa artham mithas viruddhānām saṃyogaḥ pradīpa artham hi trayaḥ padārthāḥ mithas viruddhāḥ api saṃyujyante taila vartikayoḥ viruddhaḥ agniḥ tailam api agni vartikayoḥ viruddham

original: evamapi mitho viruddhāḥ padārthāḥ puruṣārthaṃ vṛttiṃ kurvanti | tathā trayo guṇā api viruddhasvabhāvatve'pi vṛttiṃ kurvanti || 13 ||
analyzed: evam api mithas viruddhāḥ padārthāḥ puruṣa artham vṛttim kurvanti tathā trayaḥ guṇāḥ api viruddha svabhāva tve pi vṛttim kurvanti

original: para āha | ṣaṭ‌ sārūpyāṇi pūrvamuktāni | [tatra] ekavidhamupalabdhaṃ mayā | avaśiṣṭāni pañca nopalabdhāni | traiguṇyaṃ sādhitam‌ | avaśiṣṭāni pañcāpi sādhayitavyāni | āryayottaramāha |
analyzed: paraḥ āha ṣaḍ sārūpyāṇi pūrvam uktāni tatra ekavidham upalabdham mayā avaśiṣṭāni pañca na upalabdhāni traiguṇyam sādhitam avaśiṣṭāni pañca api sādhayitavyāni āryayā uttaram āha

original: avivekyādiḥ siddhastraiguṇyāttadviparyayābhāvāt‌ |
analyzed: aviveki ādiḥ siddhaḥ traiguṇyāt tad viparyaya abhāvāt

original: kāraṇaguṇātmakatvātkāryasyāvyaktamapi siddham‌ || 14 ||
analyzed: kāraṇa guṇa ātmaka tvāt kāryasya avyaktam api siddham

original: avivekyādiḥ siddha iti | avivekyādayaḥ pañca dharmā yathāpūrvamuktā vyakte siddhāḥ pradhāne'pi sidhyanti | tataḥ siddhatvātkāryasya | guṇādiparyayābhāvāditi | amī avivekyādayaḥ pañcadharmā vyakte siddhatvāt pradhāne'vaśyaṃ santīti jñāyate | kathamevam‌ | traiguṇyāt‌ | apṛthaksthāyi traiguṇyañcet‌ | [tadā] mitho'vivekīti jñāyate |
analyzed: aviveki ādiḥ siddhaḥ iti aviveki ādayaḥ pañca dharmāḥ yathāpūrvam uktāḥ vyakte siddhāḥ pradhāne api sidhyanti tatas siddha tvāt kāryasya guṇa ādi paryaya abhāvāt iti amī aviveki ādayaḥ pañca dharmāḥ vyakte siddha tvāt pradhāna ivaśyam santi iti jñāyate katham evam traiguṇyāt apṛthak sthāyi traiguṇyam ced tadā mithas viveki iti jñāyate

original: yadyaviveki, tadā viṣaya iti jñeyam‌ | yadi viṣaya ityucyate | tadā sāmānyaṃ jñeyam‌ | yadi sāmānyaṃ svīkriyate, tataḥ acetanaṃ jñāyate | yadi viṣayaḥ, yadi sāmānyam‌, yadi cācetanam‌ | tataḥ prasavadharmi jñāyate | yadi jñāyate ime ṣaḍ‌ dharmā vyakte santīti | tadā te ṣaḍ‌ dharmāḥ pradhāne'pi santīti jñāyate | kathamevaṃ jñāyate |
analyzed: yadi aviveki tadā viṣayaḥ iti jñeyam yadi viṣayaḥ iti ucyate tadā sāmānyam jñeyam yadi sāmānyam svīkriyate tatas acetanam jñāyate yadi viṣayaḥ yadi sāmānyam yadi ca acetanam tatas prasava dharmi jñāyate yadi jñāyate ime ṣaṭ dharmāḥ vyakte santi iti tadā te ṣaṭ dharmāḥ pradhāne api santi iti jñāyate katham evam jñāyate

original: viparyaye'bhāvāt‌ | mūlaprakṛtirvivarjitañcet‌ tadā kāryaṃ ṣaḍdharma na syāt‌ | yathā tantutiraskṛta[ścet‌], tadā nāsti paṭo vyatiriktaḥ | yatraiva paṭavastatraiva tantavaḥ | tantupaṭau hyaviviktau | kāryaṃ kāraṇādhīnam‌ | kāryakāraṇe ca na vivikte | kāryaguṇaḥ kāraṇaguṇamanusarati [ato]'vyaktaṃ siddhamiti |
analyzed: viparyaye bhāvāt mūlaprakṛtiḥ vivarjitam ced tadā kāryam ṣaṣ dharma na syāt yathā tantu tiraskṛtaḥ ced tadā na asti paṭaḥ vyatiriktaḥ yatra eva paṭavaḥ tatra eva tantavaḥ tantu paṭau hi aviviktau kāryam kāraṇa adhīnam kārya kāraṇe ca na vivikte kārya guṇaḥ kāraṇa guṇam anusarati atas vyaktam siddham iti

original: loke'smin‌ sarve kāryaguṇā niyamena kāraṇaguṇamanusaranti | yathā kṛṣṇatantukṛtaḥ paṭaḥ | sa hi niyamena tantukārṣṇyamanusarati | tathā vyaktādyapi traiguṇyāt‌ pañcadharma siddham‌ | kāryasya ṣaḍdharmatvājjñāyate'vyakte'pi ṣaḍdharmāḥ santīti || 14 ||
analyzed: loke asmin sarve kārya guṇāḥ niyamena kāraṇa guṇam anusaranti yathā kṛṣṇa tantu kṛtaḥ paṭaḥ sa hi niyamena tantu kārṣṇyam anusarati tathā vyakta ādi api traiguṇyāt pañca dharma siddham kāryasya ṣaṣ dharma tvāt jñāyate vyakte api ṣaṣ dharmāḥ santi iti

original: para āha | loke yadi vastu nopalabhyate | tadā tadvastu asadiṣyate | yathā dvitīyaḥ śiraḥ | tathā prakṛtirapi nopalabhyate | kathaṃ jñāyate sāstīti | ucyate | himavato bhārastatparimāṇañca na jñāyate | nahi vaktuṃ śakyate parimāṇaṃ nāstīti | tathā prakṛtirapi | kena hetunā jñātuṃ śakyate astīti |
analyzed: paraḥ āha loke yadi vastu na upalabhyate tadā tat vastu asat iṣyate yathā dvitīyaḥ śiraḥ tathā prakṛtiḥ api na upalabhyate katham jñāyate sā asti iti ucyate himavataḥ bhāraḥ tad parimāṇam ca na jñāyate nahi vaktum śakyate parimāṇam na asti iti tathā prakṛtiḥ api kena hetunā jñātum śakyate asti iti

original: bhedānāṃ parimāṇāt‌ samanvayācchaktitaḥ pravṛtteśca |
analyzed: bhedānām parimāṇāt samanvayāt śaktitaḥ pravṛtteḥ ca

original: kāraṇakāryavibhāgādavibhāgādvaiśvarūpyasya || 15 ||
analyzed: kāraṇa kārya vibhāgāt avibhāgāt vaiśvarūpyasya

original: asti pradhānam‌ | kathaṃ jñāyate | bhinnajātīnāṃ saparimāṇatvāditi | loke'smin‌ yadvastu sakartṛkam‌ | tadvastu parimāṇaparicchinnam‌ | yathā kulālaḥ saparimāṇānmṛtpiṇḍāt‌ paricchinnaparimāṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ kurute | ayaṃ ghaṭo yadi niṣkāraṇaḥ | [tadā] ghaṭaḥ paricchinnaparimāṇo na syāt‌ | ghaṭaśca notpannaḥ syāt‌ |
analyzed: asti pradhānam katham jñāyate bhinna jātīnām sa parimāṇa tvāt iti loke smin yat vastu sa kartṛkam tat vastu parimāṇa paricchinnam yathā kulālaḥ sa parimāṇāt mṛd piṇḍāt paricchinna parimāṇam ghaṭam kurute ayam ghaṭaḥ yadi niṣkāraṇaḥ tadā ghaṭaḥ paricchinna parimāṇaḥ na syāt ghaṭaḥ ca na utpannaḥ syāt

original: dṛśyate tu ghaṭaḥ paricchinnaparimāṇaḥ | tasmājjñāyate sakāraṇamiti | yathā tantuniṣpannaṃ paṭādikam | tathā sarvapadārtho'pi | eṣu dharmeṣu (tattveṣu) mahadādi vyaktamapi paricchinnaparimāṇam‌ | kiṃ [tat‌] paricchinnaṃ parimāṇam‌ | mahānekaḥ, eko'haṅkāraḥ, pañca tanmātrāṇi, ekādaśendriyāṇi, pañca mahābhūtāni |
analyzed: dṛśyate tu ghaṭaḥ paricchinna parimāṇaḥ tasmāt jñāyate sa kāraṇam iti yathā tantu niṣpannam paṭa ādikam tathā sarva padārthaḥ api eṣu dharmeṣu tattveṣu mahat ādi vyaktam api paricchinna parimāṇam kim tat paricchinnam parimāṇam mahān ekaḥ ekaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi ekādaśa indriyāṇi pañca mahābhūtāni

original: [evaṃ] vyaktamidaṃ saparimāṇaṃ dṛṣṭamasmābhiḥ | iti sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumānena jñāyate pradhānamavaśyamastīti | yadi pradhānamasat‌, vyaktamidamaparicchinnaparimāṇaṃ syāt‌ | kiñca punarasadbhavet‌ | samasvabhāvatvāditi | yathā candanakhaṇḍaḥ | tatkhaṇḍeṣu bahuṣvapi candanasvabhāvo'ntata ekaḥ | tathā vyaktamapi |
analyzed: evam vyaktam idam sa parimāṇam dṛṣṭam asmābhiḥ iti sāmānyatas dṛṣṭa anumānena jñāyate pradhānam avaśyam asti iti yadi pradhānam asat vyaktam idam aparicchinna parimāṇam syāt kiñca punar asat bhavet sama svabhāva tvāt iti yathā candana khaṇḍaḥ tad khaṇḍeṣu bahuṣu api ekaḥ tathā vyaktam api

original: mahadādiṣu vibhinneṣu traiguṇyasvabhāva ekaḥ | teṣāmekasvabhāvatvājjñāyate tat‌ sarvaṃ sakāraṇamiti | ato jñāyate pradhānamastīti | śakti[taḥ] pravṛtteśceti | yo yatra śakto bhavati | sa tatra pravartate | yathā kulālo ghaṭaghaṭikā[karaṇa]śakto ghaṭaghaṭikayoḥ pravartate | na paṭādau pravartate | iyaṃ ghaṭikā utpadyamānā śaktimāśritya sidhyati |
analyzed: mahat ādiṣu vibhinneṣu traiguṇya svabhāvaḥ ekaḥ teṣām eka svabhāva tvāt jñāyate tat sarvam sa kāraṇam iti atas jñāyate pradhānam asti iti śaktitaḥ pravṛtteḥ ca iti yaḥ yatra śaktaḥ bhavati sa tatra pravartate yathā kulālaḥ ghaṭa ghaṭikā karaṇa śaktaḥ ghaṭa ghaṭikayoḥ pravartate na paṭa ādau pravartate iyam ghaṭikā utpadyamānā śaktim āśritya sidhyati

original: sā ca śaktirniyamena sāśrayā yaduta kulālāśrayā | tathā vyaktamapi | vyaktasyāsti pravṛttiḥ | iyaṃ pravṛttiḥ śaktyā siddhyati | sā ca śaktiḥ sāśrayā | tadāśrayaḥ pradhānam‌ | śakti[taḥ] pravṛtteḥ jñāyate pradhānamastīti | kāraṇakāryavibhāgāditi | loke kāraṇakāryavibhāgaśca dṛśyate | yathā mṛtpiṇḍaḥ kāraṇam‌ | ghaṭādikaṃ kāryam‌ |

original: vyaktāvyaktaviparyāsāditi | pūrvasminnāryādvaya uktaṃ puruṣaḥ pradhānādbhinnaḥ vyaktādatiriktaśceti | tadubhayalakṣaṇaviparyāsāt‌, ubhayavaiṣamyāt‌ | trayo guṇāḥ kartāraḥ | tattriguṇavibhinnatvād‍‌ akarteti | para āha | kiṃ prayojanamanena iti | ucyate | sākṣitvasya sthāpanāt‌ | puruṣasya sākṣitvaṃ siddham‌ | puruṣasya jñātṛtvāt‌ |
analyzed: vyakta avyakta viparyāsāt iti pūrvasmin āryā dvaye uktam puruṣaḥ pradhānāt bhinnaḥ vyaktāt atiriktaḥ ca iti tad ubhaya lakṣaṇa viparyāsāt ubhaya vaiṣamyāt trayaḥ guṇāḥ kartāraḥ tad triguṇa vibhinna tvāt akartā iti paraḥ āha kim prayojanam anena iti ucyate sākṣi tvasya sthāpanāt puruṣasya sākṣi tvam siddham puruṣasya jñātṛ tvāt

original: nāvaśiṣṭāni tattvāni tathā | kaivalyamiti | prakṛtivikārābhyāṃ bhede sati puruṣasya pariśuddhatvāt kaivalyam‌ | mādhyasthyamiti | triguṇabhinnatvād‌ guṇānāṃ ca saṃkocavikāsavaiṣamyān‌ mādhyasthyamiṣyate [puruṣasya] | yathaikaḥ parivrājakaḥ kevala ekatra sthito gatāgatamanyaṃ nānusarati [kintu] kevalaṃ paśyati |
analyzed: na avaśiṣṭāni tattvāni tathā kaivalyam iti prakṛti vikārābhyām bhede sati puruṣasya pariśuddha tvāt kaivalyam mādhyasthyam iti triguṇa bhinna tvāt guṇānām ca saṃkoca vikāsa vaiṣamyāt mādhyasthyam iṣyate puruṣasya yathā ekaḥ parivrājakaḥ kevalaḥ ekatra sthitaḥ gata āgatam anyam na anusarati kintu kevalam paśyati

original: tathā trayo guṇāḥ saṃkocavikāsajananamaraṇasamarthāḥ | kevalamekaḥ puruṣaḥ paśyati tathāvyāpārān‌ | tasmānmādhyasthyamiṣyate | prakṛtivikārabhinnatvāt‌ puruṣasya sacetanatvād‌ draṣṭṛtvamucyate | tadvyāpāratvāddraṣṭetyucyate na karteti | ato guṇāḥ kurvanti ityayamarthaḥ siddhaḥ | asti puruṣaḥ | sa cāneko'kartā ityayamartho'pi siddhaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: tathā trayaḥ guṇāḥ saṃkoca vikāsa janana maraṇa samarthāḥ kevalam ekaḥ puruṣaḥ paśyati tathā vyāpārān tasmāt mādhyasthyam iṣyate prakṛti vikāra bhinna tvāt puruṣasya sa cetana tvāt draṣṭṛ tvam ucyate tad vyāpāra tvāt draṣṭā iti ucyate na kartā iti atas guṇāḥ kurvanti iti ayam arthaḥ siddhaḥ asti puruṣaḥ sa ca anekaḥ kartā iti ayam arthaḥ api siddhaḥ

original: para āha | yadyakartā puruṣaḥ, ko'dhyavasāyaṃ karoti dharmaṃ cariṣyāmīti | aniṣṭaṃ parihariṣyāmi praṇidhānaṃ vā sādhayiṣyāmīti ko'dhyavasāyaṃ karoti | yadi trayo guṇāḥ kurvanti tamadhyavasāyam‌ | eṣāṃ sacetanatvaṃ bhavet‌ | [nedamiṣṭam‌] guṇānāmacetanatvasya prāgupanyāsāt‌ | yadi puruṣo'dhyavasāyaṃ karoti | tadā puruṣaḥ kartā siddhyet‌ |
analyzed: paraḥ āha yadi akartā puruṣaḥ kaḥ udhyavasāyam karoti dharmam cariṣyāmi iti aniṣṭam parihariṣyāmi praṇidhānam vā sādhayiṣyāmi iti kaḥ udhyavasāyam karoti yadi trayaḥ guṇāḥ kurvanti tam adhyavasāyam eṣām sa cetana tvam bhavet na idam iṣṭam guṇānām acetana tvasya prāk upanyāsāt yadi puruṣaḥ udhyavasāyam karoti tadā puruṣaḥ kartā siddhyet

original: trayo guṇāḥ puruṣasaṃyogāditi | ime guṇā acetanāḥ kurvanti | puruṣaḥ sacetano na karoti | anayordvayoḥ saṃyogādguṇāścetanāvanta iva [bhavanti] | yathā dagdho ghaṭo'gninā saṃyukta uṣṇaḥ, salilena saṃyuktaḥ śītaḥ | tathā trayo guṇāścetanāvatā saṃyuktāścetanāvanta iva kurvantyadhyavasāyam‌ | ata uktamacetanāścetanāvanta iveti |
analyzed: trayaḥ guṇāḥ puruṣa saṃyogāt iti ime guṇāḥ acetanāḥ kurvanti puruṣaḥ sa cetanaḥ na karoti anayoḥ dvayoḥ saṃyogāt guṇāḥ cetanāvantaḥ iva bhavanti yathā dagdhaḥ ghaṭaḥ agninā saṃyuktaḥ uṣṇaḥ salilena saṃyuktaḥ śītaḥ tathā trayaḥ guṇāḥ cetanāvatā saṃyuktāḥ cetanāvantaḥ iva kurvanti adhyavasāyam atas uktam acetanāḥ cetanāvantaḥ iva iti

original: yathā rājā puruṣeṇa saṃyujyate imaṃ puruṣaṃ niyokṣya iti | sa puruṣo'pi rājñā saṃyujyate | rājā me vṛttiṃ dāsyatīti | ato rājapuruṣayoḥ saṃyogo'rthavaśātsiddhaḥ | tathā pradhānapuruṣayoḥ saṃyuktatvamapi | puruṣasya darśanārthaṃ pradhānasya kaivalyārthaṃ paṅgvandhavatsaṃyogaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
analyzed: yathā rājā puruṣeṇa saṃyujyate imam puruṣam niyokṣye iti sa puruṣaḥ api rājñā saṃyujyate rājā me vṛttim dāsyati iti atas rāja puruṣayoḥ saṃyogaḥ ūrtha vaśāt siddhaḥ tathā pradhāna puruṣayoḥ saṃyukta tvam api puruṣasya darśana artham pradhānasya kaivalya artham paṅgu andha vat saṃyogaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ

original: purā kila vaṇiksārtha ujjayinīṃ prasthitaḥ caurairabhihataḥ pṛthak‌ viśliṣṭo jagāma | [tadā] eko jātyandhaḥ eko jātipaṅguśca sarvajanotsṛṣṭāvāstām‌ | andhaḥ samantāccaṅkramamāṇaḥ āsīnena paṅgunā dṛṣṭaḥ | paṅgurapṛcchat‌ | kastvamiti | andhaḥ pratyavadat‌ | ahaṃ jātyandhaḥ na jānāmi yena samantāccaṅkrame | tvaṃ punaḥ kaḥ | paṅguḥ pratyavadat‌ |
analyzed: purā kila vaṇij sārthaḥ ujjayinīm prasthitaḥ cauraiḥ abhihataḥ pṛthak viśliṣṭaḥ jagāma tadā ekaḥ jāti andhaḥ ekaḥ jāti paṅguḥ ca sarva jana utsṛṣṭau āstām andhaḥ samantāt caṅkramamāṇaḥ āsīnena paṅgunā dṛṣṭaḥ paṅguḥ apṛcchat kaḥ tvam iti andhaḥ pratyavadat aham jāti andhaḥ na jānāmi yena samantāt caṅkrame tvam punar kaḥ paṅguḥ pratyavadat

original: ahaṃ jātipaṅguḥ mārgadarśanamātrakṣamaḥ asamartho gantumiti | [jātyandho'vadat‌] tasmānmama skandha upaviśa | ahaṃ mārgaṃ netuṃ śaknomi | tvaṃ mama panthānaṃ darśaya | iti | evaṃ dvau puruṣau mithaḥsaṃyogena [svā]dhiṣṭhānadeśamabhyagacchatām‌ | tayoḥ saṃyogo'rthavaśāt‌ siddhaḥ | gatvā ca tau [svā]dhiṣṭhānadeśaṃ pṛthak‌ pṛthag‌ vyayujyetām‌ |
analyzed: aham jāti paṅguḥ mārga darśana mātra kṣamaḥ asamarthaḥ gantum iti jāti andhaḥ vadat tasmāt mama skandhe upaviśa aham mārgam netum śaknomi tvam mama panthānam darśaya iti evam dvau puruṣau mithas saṃyogena sva adhiṣṭhāna deśam abhyagacchatām tayoḥ saṃyogaḥ ūrtha vaśāt siddhaḥ gatvā ca tau sva adhiṣṭhāna deśam pṛthak pṛthak vyayujyetām

original: tathā puruṣaḥ pradhānadarśanakāla eva mokṣaṃ labhate | pradhānamapi puruṣasya kaivalyaṃ kṛtvā pṛthaṅnivartate | arthavaśāllokasarga iti | puruṣaḥ anyadarśanārthaṃ pradhānaṃ kaivalyārthaṃ saṃyujyete | ayaṃ saṃyogaḥ lokaṃ sṛjati | yathā strīpuruṣobhayasaṃyogātputraḥ saṃbhavati | tathā pradhānapuruṣasaṃyogo mahadādi sṛjati || 21 ||
analyzed: tathā puruṣaḥ pradhāna darśana kāle eva mokṣam labhate pradhānam api puruṣasya kaivalyam kṛtvā pṛthak nivartate artha vaśāt loka sargaḥ iti puruṣaḥ anya darśana artham pradhānam kaivalya artham saṃyujyete ayam saṃyogaḥ lokam sṛjati yathā strī puruṣa ubhaya saṃyogāt putraḥ saṃbhavati tathā pradhāna puruṣa saṃyogaḥ mahat ādi sṛjati

original: prakṛteḥ krameṇa jāyata iti | prakṛtiriti pradhānaṃ vā brahma vā bahudhātmakaṃ vākhyāyate | yadi krameṇa jāyate | tadā prakṛtermūlatvānnāsti [anyad‌] yato jāyeta | prakṛtermahān‌ prathamamutpadyate | mahāniti buddhirvā saṃvittirvā vibhurvā matirvā prajñā vākhyāyate | yatra mahān‌ tatra matiḥ | ato mahān‌ matirityākhyāṃ labhate |
analyzed: prakṛteḥ krameṇa jāyate iti prakṛtiḥ iti pradhānam vā brahma vā bahudhā ātmakam vā ākhyāyate yadi krameṇa jāyate tadā prakṛteḥ mūla tvāt na asti anyat yatas jāyeta prakṛteḥ mahān prathamam utpadyate mahān iti buddhiḥ vā saṃvittiḥ vā vibhuḥ vā matiḥ vā prajñā vā ākhyāyate yatra mahān tatra matiḥ atas mahān matiḥ iti ākhyām labhate

original: tato mahato'haṅkāro jāyate | ahaṅkāra iti bhūtādirvā vaikṛto vā taijaso vākhyāyate | tato'haṅkārāt‌ ṣoḍaśaka utpadyate | ṣoḍaśaka iti pañcatanmātrāṇi pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi mana indriyañca | pañcatanmātrāṇi śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ, ime pañcatanmātrātmakāḥ tanmātraśaktayo vā | śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇāni pañca jñānendriyāṇi |
analyzed: tatas mahataḥ haṅkāraḥ jāyate ahaṅkāraḥ iti bhūtādiḥ vā vaikṛtaḥ vā taijasaḥ vā ākhyāyate tatas uhaṅkārāt ṣoḍaśakaḥ utpadyate ṣoḍaśakaḥ iti pañca tanmātrāṇi pañca jñāna indriyāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi manaḥ indriyam ca pañca tanmātrāṇi śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhāḥ ime pañca tanmātra ātmakāḥ tanmātra śaktayaḥ vā śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇāni pañca jñāna indriyāṇi

original: vākpāṇipādopasthapāyavaḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi | ayaṃ ṣoḍaśakaḥ ahaṅkārādutpadyate | ata uktaṃ mahān‌ [tataḥ] ahaṅkāraḥ [tataḥ] ṣoḍaśaka iti | atha ṣoḍaśake santi pañca[tanmātrāṇi] tebhyaḥ pañcabhūtāni jāyante | [tatra] śabdatanmātrādākāśamahābhūtamutpadyate | sparśatanmātrādvāyumahābhūtamutpadyate | rūpatanmātrāttejomahābhūtamutpadyate |

original: trayodaśamadhye buddhīndriyāṇi viśeṣāviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti iti | eṣāṃ trayodaśakaraṇānāṃ madhye pañcabuddhīndriyāṇi saviśeṣanirviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | saviśeṣāstriguṇamayāḥ | nirviśeṣāḥ kevalaikaguṇāḥ | yathā svarge pañcaviṣayāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhākhyāḥ | ete pañcaviṣayā nirviśeṣāḥ | samasattvātmakatvāt‌ |

original: ete pañcaviṣayā arajastamaskāḥ | manuṣyagatau pañcaviṣayāḥ saviśeṣāḥ sattvarajastamoyogasiddhāḥ | tasmāddevānāṃ buddhīndriyāṇi nirviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | manuṣyāṇāṃ buddhīndriyāṇi tu sattvarajastamorūpaviśeṣavadviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | tasmā[duktaṃ] buddhīndriyāṇi viśeṣāviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | iti | vāk‌ śabdamātraviṣayeti |

original: devavāk‌ manuṣyavāk‌ ca śabdamātraviṣayā nāmapadavyañjanāni bhāṣate | śeṣāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ pañcāpi viṣayā iti | pāṇīndriyaṃ pañcaviṣayātmakaṃ pañcā[tmaka]viṣayān‌ gṛhṇāti | tadyathā pāṇirghaṭaṃ gṛhṇāti | yathā pāṇiḥ, tathā śeṣāṇyapīndriyāṇi | evaṃ catvārīndriyāṇi pañcaviṣayasaṃsthānāni pañcā[tmaka]viṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti || 34 ||
analyzed: deva vāc manuṣya vāc ca śabda mātra viṣayā nāma pada vyañjanāni bhāṣate śeṣāṇām caturṇām pañca api viṣayāḥ iti pāṇi indriyam pañca viṣaya ātmakam pañca ātmaka viṣayān gṛhṇāti tat yathā pāṇiḥ ghaṭam gṛhṇāti yathā pāṇiḥ tathā śeṣāṇi api indriyāṇi evam catvāri indriyāṇi pañca viṣaya saṃsthānāni pañca ātmaka viṣayān gṛhṇanti

original: athendriyāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāntaramāryayāha |
analyzed: atha indriyāṇām lakṣaṇa antaram āryayā āha

analyzed: tasmāt trividham karaṇam dvāri dvārāṇi śeṣāṇi

original: buddhiḥ sāntaḥkaraṇā sarvaṃ viṣayamavagāhate | iti | buddherahaṅkāreṇa manaindriyeṇa sadā yogād‌ uktaṃ buddhiḥ sāntaḥkaraṇeti | trilokān‌ viṣayān‌ trikālān‌ viṣayāṃścāvagāhate | ata uktaṃ sarvaṃ viṣayamavagāhata iti | tasmāttrividhaṃ karaṇaṃ dvāri | iti | buddhyādi trividhaṃ karaṇa[mātmānaṃ] dvārāṇāmadhipaṃ karoti |
analyzed: buddhiḥ sa antaḥkaraṇā sarvam viṣayam avagāhate iti buddheḥ ahaṅkāreṇa manaḥ indriyeṇa sadā yogāt uktam buddhiḥ sa antaḥkaraṇā iti tri lokān viṣayān tri kālān viṣayān ca avagāhate atas uktam sarvam viṣayam avagāhate iti tasmāt trividham karaṇam dvāri iti buddhi ādi trividham karaṇam ātmānam dvārāṇām adhipam karoti

original: yadi buddhyādi trividhaṃ karaṇaṃ suyuktaṃ cakṣurindriye vartate | [tadā] taccakṣurindriyaṃ rūpaṃ prakāśayati na śeṣāṇīndriyāṇi | imāni trīṇi [karaṇāni] ekendriyasamavāyāt‌ trilokaviṣayān‌ trikāla[viṣayāṃ]ścāvagāhante | tasmāducyate imāni trīṇi [karaṇāni] daśakaraṇānyadhitiṣṭhanti iti | śeṣāṇi indriyāṇi sarvāṇi dvārāṇi iti |
analyzed: yadi buddhi ādi trividham karaṇam su yuktam cakṣuḥ indriye vartate tadā tat cakṣuḥ indriyam rūpam prakāśayati na śeṣāṇi indriyāṇi imāni trīṇi karaṇāni eka indriya samavāyāt tri loka viṣayān tri kāla viṣayān ca avagāhante tasmāt ucyate imāni trīṇi karaṇāni daśa karaṇāni adhitiṣṭhanti iti śeṣāṇi indriyāṇi sarvāṇi dvārāṇi iti

original: yaduta pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi | tri[karaṇā]nusāritvād‌ vivṛtāni saṃvṛtāni vā bhavanti | yadi trikaṃ cakṣuṣi vartate | tadā cakṣurdvāraṃ vivṛtaṃ purovartiviṣayamavagāhate | śeṣāṇi dvārāṇi tu saṃvṛtāni viṣayaṃ nāvabuddhyante | anyānusāritvāt‌ kevalaṃ dvārāṇi na vastutaḥ karaṇāni |
analyzed: yat uta pañca jñāna indriyāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi tri karaṇa anusāri tvāt vivṛtāni saṃvṛtāni vā bhavanti yadi trikam cakṣuṣi vartate tadā cakṣuḥ dvāram vivṛtam purovarti viṣayam avagāhate śeṣāṇi dvārāṇi tu saṃvṛtāni viṣayam na avabuddhyante anya anusāri tvāt kevalam dvārāṇi na vastutas karaṇāni

original: karaṇāni pradīpakalpānīti | yaduta pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi ahaṅkāro manaindriyañca | yathā pradīpa ekatrāvasthitaḥ padārthān‌ samaṃ prakāśayati | evaṃ karaṇāni trīlokaviṣayān‌ prakāśayati | ata uktaṃ pradīpakalpānīti | guṇamanusṛtya parasparavilakṣaṇānīti | parasparavidharmāṇi | śrotraṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇāti na rūpam‌ |
analyzed: karaṇāni pradīpa kalpāni iti yat uta pañca jñāna indriyāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi ahaṅkāraḥ mana indriyam ca yathā pradīpaḥ ekatra avasthitaḥ padārthān samam prakāśayati evam karaṇāni tri loka viṣayān prakāśayati atas uktam pradīpa kalpāni iti guṇam anusṛtya paraspara vilakṣaṇāni iti paraspara vidharmāṇi śrotram śabdam gṛhṇāti na rūpam

original: cakṣustu rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti na śabdam‌ | yāvannāsikā kevalaṃ gandhaṃ gṛhṇāti na rasam‌ | jñānendriyeṣu indriyaṃ prativiṣayaṃ niyataṃ vilakṣaṇañca | ata uktaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇānīti | karmendriyamapyevam‌ | vāk‌ kevalaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ vyavaharati | na śeṣāṃ vṛttiṃ karoti | yāvadbuddhiḥ kevalamadhyavasāyaṃ karoti | ahaṅkāraḥ kevalamabhimānaṃ karoti |
analyzed: cakṣuḥ tu rūpam gṛhṇāti na śabdam yāvat nāsikā kevalam gandham gṛhṇāti na rasam jñāna indriyeṣu indriyam prati viṣayam niyatam vilakṣaṇam ca atas uktam paraspara vilakṣaṇāni iti karmendriyam api evam vāc kevalam bhāṣaṇam vyavaharati na śeṣām vṛttim karoti yāvat buddhiḥ kevalam adhyavasāyam karoti ahaṅkāraḥ kevalam abhimānam karoti

original: manaḥ kevalaṃ saṃkalpaṃ karoti | ato'pyuktaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇānīti | tadvailakṣaṇyaṃ katham‌ | trīn guṇānanutsṛtyāhaṅkāro viṣamaḥ pravartate | ata ahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi viṣamāṇi sṛjati | trilokaviṣayān‌ prakāśya puruṣārthaṃ buddhau prayacchantīti | imāni dvādaśendriyāṇī lokaviṣayān‌ prakāśya sarvān‌ buddhau prayacchanti |
analyzed: manaḥ kevalam saṃkalpam karoti atas upi uktam paraspara vilakṣaṇāni iti tad vailakṣaṇyam katham trīn guṇān an utsṛtya ahaṅkāraḥ viṣamaḥ pravartate ahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi viṣamāṇi sṛjati tri loka viṣayān prakāśya puruṣa artham buddhau prayacchanti iti imāni dvādaśa indriyāṇī loka viṣayān prakāśya sarvān buddhau prayacchanti

original: yathā rāṣṭre sarve'mātyajanā deśadhanāni saṃgṛhya rāṣṭrapālāya prayacchanti | evaṃ viṣayā dvādaśendriyairbuddhau pradīyante | ato buddhaḥ puruṣaṃ [viṣayān‌] pradarśayati | ata uktaṃ puruṣārthaṃ buddhau prayacchantīti || 36 ||
analyzed: yathā rāṣṭre sarva imā atya janāḥ deśa dhanāni saṃgṛhya rāṣṭra pālāya prayacchanti evam viṣayāḥ dvādaśa indriyaiḥ buddhau pradīyante atas buddhaḥ puruṣam viṣayān pradarśayati atas uktam puruṣa artham buddhau prayacchanti iti

original: para āha | kasmādindriyāṇi viṣayān prakāśya na svayaṃ puruṣāya pradarśayanti | āryayottaramāha |
analyzed: paraḥ āha kasmāt indriyāṇi viṣayān prakāśya na svayam puruṣāya pradarśayanti āryayā uttaram āha

analyzed: sarvam pratyupabhogam yasmāt puruṣasya sādhayati buddhiḥ

original: saiva ca viśinaṣṭi tataḥ pradhānapuruṣāntaraṃ sūkṣmam‌ || 37 ||
analyzed: sā eva ca viśinaṣṭi tatas pradhāna puruṣa antaram sūkṣmam

original: puruṣasya sarvaṃ pratyupabhogaṃ yasmādbuddhiḥ sādhayati iti | puruṣasyopabhogaḥ sarvatra na samaḥ | yadi vā manuṣyagatau yadi vā devagatau yadi vā tiryaggatau daśaviṣayopabhogo yāvadaṣṭaiśvaryopabhogaṃ [na samaḥ] | jñānendriyakarmendriyadaśabāhyakaraṇāni imān‌ viṣayān‌ prakāśya buddhāvarpayanti | buddhiḥ puruṣe'rpayituṃ svīkaroti |
analyzed: puruṣasya sarvam pratyupabhogam yasmāt buddhiḥ sādhayati iti puruṣasya upabhogaḥ sarvatra na samaḥ yadi vā manuṣya gatau yadi vā deva gatau yadi vā tiryaggatau daśa viṣaya upabhogaḥ yāvat aṣṭa aiśvarya upabhogam na samaḥ jñāna indriya karmendriya daśa bāhya karaṇāni imān viṣayān prakāśya buddhau arpayanti buddhiḥ puruṣa īrpayitum svīkaroti

original: tena puruṣa upabhogaṃ labhate | anena ca hetunā buddhiḥ kramaśaḥ puruṣaṃ yatheṣṭamupabhoktāramaiśvaryasukhasya lābhinaṃ ca karoti yāvatprajñā notpadyate | kiñca paścātkāle pradhānapuruṣayoḥ sūkṣmamantaraṃ darśayati | iti | paścātkālaḥ prājñaprādurbhāvakālaḥ | pradhānapuruṣau viviktāvitīmaṃ vivekamanabhyastācāyacaryā janā na paśyanti |
analyzed: tena puruṣaḥ upabhogam labhate anena ca hetunā buddhiḥ kramaśas puruṣam yathā iṣṭam upabhoktāram aiśvarya sukhasya lābhinam ca karoti yāvat prajñā na utpadyate kiñca paścātkāle pradhāna puruṣayoḥ sūkṣmam antaram darśayati iti paścātkālaḥ prājña prādurbhāva kālaḥ pradhāna puruṣau viviktau iti imam vivekam anabhyasta ācāya caryāḥ janāḥ na paśyanti

original: ata uktaṃ sūkṣmamiti | sā ca viveke dvāramiti trayodaśake buddhireva puruṣaṃ darśayati | darśanaṃ kiṃlakṣaṇam‌ | yaduta pradhānapuruṣau bhinnau, trayo guṇā bhinnāḥ, buddhirbhinnā, ahaṅkāro bhinnaḥ, ekādaśendriyāṇi bhinnāni, pañcatanmātrāṇi bhinnāni, pañcamahābhūtāni bhinnāni śarīraṃ bhinnamiti darśanam‌ |
analyzed: atas uktam sūkṣmam iti sā ca viveke dvāram iti trayodaśake buddhiḥ eva puruṣam darśayati darśanam kiṃlakṣaṇam yat uta pradhāna puruṣau bhinnau trayaḥ guṇāḥ bhinnāḥ buddhiḥ bhinnā ahaṅkāraḥ bhinnaḥ ekādaśa indriyāṇi bhinnāni pañca tanmātrāṇi bhinnāni pañca mahābhūtāni bhinnāni śarīram bhinnam iti darśanam

original: evamādibhedabuddhiḥ puruṣasya jñānamutpādayati | tasmātpuruṣo mokṣaṃ labhate | yathoktaṃ prāk‌ | pañcaviṃśatitattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vaset‌ | jaṭī muṇḍī śikhī vāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || iti | tasmātkevalaṃ buddhirekā puruṣasya vastutaḥ karaṇam‌ || 37 ||
analyzed: evamādi bheda buddhiḥ puruṣasya jñānam utpādayati tasmāt puruṣaḥ mokṣam labhate yathā uktam prāk pañcaviṃśati tattva jñaḥ yatra tatra āśrame vaset jaṭī muṇḍī śikhī vā api mucyate na atra saṃśayaḥ iti tasmāt kevalam buddhiḥ ekā puruṣasya vastutas karaṇam

original: para āha | pūrvamāryāyāmuktamindriyāṇi viśeṣāviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti iti | ke [te] viśeṣāviśeṣāḥ | āryayottaramāha |
analyzed: paraḥ āha pūrvam āryāyām uktam indriyāṇi viśeṣa aviśeṣa viṣayān gṛhṇanti iti ke te viśeṣa aviśeṣāḥ āryayā uttaram āha

original: tanmātrāṇyaviśeṣāstebhyo bhūtāni pañca pañcabhyaḥ |
analyzed: tanmātrāṇi aviśeṣāḥ tebhyaḥ bhūtāni pañca pañcabhyaḥ

analyzed: ete smṛtāḥ viśeṣāḥ śāntāḥ ghorāḥ ca mūḍhāḥ ca

original: pañcatanmātrāṇyaviśeṣā iti | bhavānāha sma | ke viśeṣāviśeṣā iti | adhunā samādhāsyate | ahaṅkārādutpadyante pañcatanmātrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi śāntāni sattvalakṣaṇāni ca | etānyeva devānāṃ viṣayā aviśeṣāśca | devānāṃ śokamohābhāvāt‌ | tebhya utpannāni pañcamahābhūtāni | bhautikaviṣayāḥ saviśeṣā iti | śabdatanmātrādākāśamutpannam‌ |

original: tatrotpannarāgabandhā devādayo mokṣaṃ na labhante | aiśvaryāsaṅgena saṃsāre saṃsaraṇād‌ ukto mohasyāṣṭavidhabhedaḥ | aṣṭāvādyāḥ prakṛtibandha ityākhyāyante | aṣṭāvantimā vikṛtibandha ityākhyāyante | mahāmohasya daśeti | pañcatanmātrāṇi sattvalakṣaṇāni devānāṃ viṣayāḥ | ime pañca viṣayāḥ pañcamahābhūtaiḥ saṃyuktāḥ triguṇalakṣaṇā [bhavanti] |
analyzed: tatra utpanna rāga bandhāḥ deva ādayaḥ mokṣam na labhante aiśvarya āsaṅgena saṃsāre saṃsaraṇāt uktaḥ mohasya aṣṭavidha bhedaḥ aṣṭāvādyāḥ prakṛtibandhaḥ iti ākhyāyante aṣṭau antimāḥ vikṛtibandhaḥ iti ākhyāyante mahāmohasya daśa iti pañca tanmātrāṇi sattva lakṣaṇāni devānām viṣayāḥ ime pañca viṣayāḥ pañca mahābhūtaiḥ saṃyuktāḥ triguṇa lakṣaṇāḥ bhavanti

original: [tatraikaṃ] kaścitpuruṣaḥ pṛcchati | kiṃ buddhvā pravrajito'si iti | ayaṃ prativadati | jānāmyeṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ lokāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ tathyaṃ kāraṇam‌ | ataḥ pravrajito'smi iti | sa brāhmaṇaḥ kevalaṃ jānāti pradhānaṃ kāraṇamiti | na jānāti nityamanityaṃ vā sacetanamacetanaṃ vā saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vā vyāpyavyāpi vā iti | kintu jānāti astīti kāraṇañceti |
