original: atastuṣṭirjāyate | sa na bhavati muktaḥ | iyaṃ tuṣṭiḥ prakṛtyā jātā | atha dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pṛcchati | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa prativadati | ahaṃ vijānāmi pradhānaṃ lokakāraṇamiti | mokṣakāraṇamupādānamiti ca jñātavānasmi | pradhānaṃ tathyaṃ kāraṇamiti [jñāne] satyapi yadyupādānaṃ nāsti | mokṣo na sidhyati | tasmādupādānaṃ svīkaromi |
analyzed: atas tuṣṭiḥ jāyate sa na bhavati muktaḥ iyam tuṣṭiḥ prakṛtyā jātā atha dvitīyam brāhmaṇam pṛcchati kim jñātvā pravrajitaḥ asi iti sa prativadati aham vijānāmi pradhānam loka kāraṇam iti mokṣa kāraṇam upādānam iti ca jñātavān asmi pradhānam tathyam kāraṇam iti jñāne sati api yadi upādānam na asti mokṣaḥ na sidhyati tasmāt upādānam svīkaromi

original: upādānaṃ sarvapravrajitānuṣṭhānapaddhyatyanukaraṇam‌ | [tacca] upakaraṇaṃ caturvidham‌ | tridaṇḍakuṇḍikākaṣāyamaṅgalāni | bhasmakośikā rudrākṣamaṇiḥ tritantuveṣṭitakāyatvaṃ mantrapaṭhanaṃ jaṭāgre kuśavallīsthāpanamiti | etāni pañca śikṣāpacaryopakaraṇāni aśuddhimapanayantīti maṅgalamityucyante | prāk‌ siddhaiḥ tribhiḥ sahāṣṭopakaraṇāni |
analyzed: upādānam sarva pravrajita anuṣṭhāna paddhyati anukaraṇam tat ca upakaraṇam caturvidham tridaṇḍa kuṇḍikā kaṣāyamaṅgalāni bhasmakośikā rudrākṣa maṇiḥ tri tantu veṣṭita kāya tvam mantra paṭhanam jaṭā agre kuśa vallī sthāpanam iti etāni pañca śikṣā apacarya upakaraṇāni aśuddhim apanayanti iti maṅgalam iti ucyante prāk siddhaiḥ tribhiḥ saha aṣṭa upakaraṇāni

original: ebhyo mokṣaṃ lapsye ityanena pravrajito'hamiti | tasmādvitīyā tuṣṭirupādānākhyā | anayā tuṣṭyā na mokṣaṃ labhate | kevalaṃ jānāti pradhānaṃ kāraṇamiti | nādhikam‌ | atha tṛtīyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pṛcchati | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa pratyāha | pradhānaṃ catvāryupādānāni kiṃ kartuṃ samarthāni |
analyzed: ebhyaḥ mokṣam lapsye iti anena pravrajitā uham iti tasmāt dvitīyā tuṣṭiḥ upādāna ākhyā anayā tuṣṭyā na mokṣam labhate kevalam jānāti pradhānam kāraṇam iti na adhikam atha tṛtīyam brāhmaṇam pṛcchati kim jñātvā pravrajitā usi iti sa pratyāha pradhānam catvāri upādānāni kim kartum samarthāni

original: jānāmi upādānaṃ vināpi [kālena] mokṣaṃ lapsye iti pravrajyāmicchāmi | iti | ayaṃ tṛtīyo na mukto bhavati | kasmāt‌ | pañcaviṃśatipadārthājñānāt‌ | iyaṃ tṛtīyā tuṣṭiḥ kālatuṣṭyākhyā | atha pṛcchati caturthaṃ brāhmaṇam‌ | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa pratyāha | pradhānamupādānaṃ kālo vā kiṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ | yadi bhāgyalābhahīnaḥ |
analyzed: jānāmi upādānam vinā api kālena mokṣam lapsye iti pravrajyām icchāmi iti ayam tṛtīyaḥ na muktaḥ bhavati kasmāt pañcaviṃśati padārtha ajñānāt iyam tṛtīyā tuṣṭiḥ kāla tuṣṭi ākhyā atha pṛcchati caturtham brāhmaṇam kim jñātvā pravrajitaḥ asi iti sa pratyāha pradhānam upādānam kālaḥ vā kim kartum samarthaḥ yadi bhāgya lābha hīnaḥ

original: ahaṃ jñātavān‌ bhāgyalābhāt‌ mokṣaṃ lapsya iti | ataḥ pravrajito'smi | iti | ayaṃ caturtho'pi na mucyate | jñānābhāvāt‌ | iyaṃ caturthī tuṣṭirbhāgyalābhatuṣṭyākhyā | etāścatasrastuṣṭayo naimittikāḥ siddhāḥ | bāhyāstuṣṭayaḥ pañcaviṣayoparamādāhatya naveti | bāhyāstuṣṭayaḥ pañcavidhā bhavanti |
analyzed: aham jñātavān bhāgya lābhāt mokṣam lapsye iti atas pravrajitaḥ asmi iti ayam caturthaḥ api na mucyate jñāna abhāvāt iyam caturthī tuṣṭiḥ bhāgya lābha tuṣṭi ākhyā etāḥ catasraḥ tuṣṭayaḥ naimittikāḥ siddhāḥ bāhyāḥ tuṣṭayaḥ pañca viṣaya uparamāt āhatya navā iti bāhyāḥ tuṣṭayaḥ pañcavidhāḥ bhavanti

original: pañcaviṣayāṇāṃ dūrata uparamāt‌ [arjanarakṣaṇakṣayātṛptihiṃsādoṣān‌ dṛṣṭvā] | yathā ekaḥ puruṣaḥ pañca brāhmaṇaparivrājakān‌ dṛṣṭvā kramoṇopagamya pṛcchati | ādau prathamaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pṛcchati | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa pratyāha | loke pañca viṣayāḥ santi |
analyzed: pañca viṣayāṇām dūratas uparamāt arjana rakṣaṇa kṣaya atṛpti hiṃsā doṣān dṛṣṭvā yathā ekaḥ puruṣaḥ pañca brāhmaṇa parivrājakān dṛṣṭvā pṛcchati ādau prathamam brāhmaṇam pṛcchati kim jñātvā pravrajitaḥ asi iti sa pratyāha loke pañca viṣayāḥ santi

original: tadviṣaryārjanārthaṃ vṛttayaḥ - yadi vā kṛṣiḥ yadi vā pāśupālyaṃ yadi vā rājasevā yadi vā vāṇijyam‌ - sarvā[stā] duṣkarāḥ | tāścatasro vṛttīrvihāya yadi vā cauryaṃ kriyatām‌ | iyaṃ [api] viṣayārjanavṛttirniyamena duṣkarā | svaparapīḍanāt‌ | etā vṛttī[rduṣkarā] dṛṣṭvā pravrajyāmicchāmi | ayaṃ pañcamo brāhmaṇo na mukto bhavati | atattvajñatvāt‌ |
analyzed: tad viṣaryā arjana artham vṛttayaḥ yadi vā kṛṣiḥ yadi vā pāśupālyam yadi vā rāja sevā yadi vā vāṇijyam sarvāḥ tāḥ duṣkarāḥ tāḥ catasraḥ vṛttīḥ vihāya yadi vā cauryam kriyatām iyam api viṣaya arjana vṛttiḥ niyamena duṣkarā sva para pīḍanāt etāḥ vṛttīḥ duṣkarāḥ dṛṣṭvā pravrajyām icchāmi ayam pañcamaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ na muktaḥ bhavati a tattva jña tvāt

original: atha dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pṛcchati | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa pratyāha | ahaṃ jānāmi pañcaviṣayā anveṣaṇena labhyante pūrvavatkṛṣyādyupāyaiḥ | viṣayān‌ labdhvā rakṣaṇaṃ duṣkaram‌ | kasmāt‌ | pañcagṛhacaryāmitho viruddhāḥ | viṣayarakṣaṇenātmā paraścopahanyate | rakṣaṇaduḥkhadarśitvāt‌ viṣayoparataḥ pravrajito'hamiti |
analyzed: atha dvitīyam brāhmaṇam pṛcchati kim jñātvā pravrajitaḥ asi iti sa pratyāha aham jānāmi pañca viṣayāḥ anveṣaṇena labhyante pūrvavat kṛṣi ādi upāyaiḥ viṣayān labdhvā rakṣaṇam duṣkaram kasmāt pañca gṛha caryā mithas viruddhāḥ viṣaya rakṣaṇena ātmā paraḥ ca upahanyate rakṣaṇa duḥkha darśi tvāt viṣaya uparataḥ pravrajitaḥ aham iti

original: asya ṣaṣṭhasyāpi na mokṣo'sti | atattvajñatvāt‌ | atha tṛtīyaṃ pṛcchati | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa pratyāha | ahamalabdhamanveṣṭumārjayituñca kṣamaḥ | ārjayitvā rakṣāmi akṣayāya | ime pañca viṣayāḥ svopabhogāt‌ svabhāvataḥ kṣīyante | kṣayakāle mahadduḥhamutpadyate | eṣāṃ kṣīṇaviṣayāṇāmavadyadarśitvātpravrajyāmicchāmi | iti |
analyzed: asya ṣaṣṭhasya api na mokṣaḥ usti atattva jña tvāt atha tṛtīyam pṛcchati kim jñātvā pravrajitaḥ asi iti sa pratyāha aham alabdham anveṣṭum ārjayitum ca kṣamaḥ ārjayitvā rakṣāmi akṣayāya ime pañca viṣayāḥ sva upabhogāt svabhāvataḥ kṣīyante kṣaya kāle mahat duḥham utpadyate eṣām kṣīṇa viṣayāṇām avadya darśi tvāt pravrajyām icchāmi iti

original: ayamapi na mokṣaṃ labhate | atattvajñatvāt‌ | atha caturthaṃ pṛcchati | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa pratyāha | ahamalabdhamanveṣṭuṃ śakta ārjayāmi | arjayitvā ca rakṣāmi | kṣīṇe'pi punarārjayāmi | tathā cet‌ kṛtaḥ pravrajitaḥ | pañcendriyāṇi na tṛptāni | uttarottaramutkṛṣṭānveṣitvāt‌ | eṣāmindriyāṇāṃ doṣaṃ paśyāmi | ataḥ pravrajyāmicchāmi |
analyzed: ayam api na mokṣam labhate atattva jña tvāt atha caturtham pṛcchati kim jñātvā pravrajitaḥ asi iti sa pratyāha aham alabdham anveṣṭum śaktaḥ ārjayāmi arjayitvā ca rakṣāmi kṣīṇe api punar ārjayāmi tathā ced kṛtaḥ pravrajitaḥ pañca indriyāṇi na tṛptāni uttarottaram utkṛṣṭa anveṣi tvāt eṣām indriyāṇām doṣam paśyāmi atas pravrajyām icchāmi

original: iti | asyāṣṭamasyāpi na mokṣo'sti | atattvajñatvāt‌ | atha pañcamaṃ pṛcchati | kiṃ jñātvā pravrajito'sīti | sa pratyāha | ahamalabdhalābhāyānveṣṭuṃ kṣamaḥ labdhvā rakṣāmyakṣayāya | upabhujya punarārjayituñca kṣamaḥ | yadyutkṛṣṭamicchāmi | ahaṃ [ta]dapi labdhuṃ kṣamaḥ | tathā cetkutaḥ pravrajitaḥ | viṣayā[rjana]vṛtticatuṣṭayenānyo hiṃsyate |
analyzed: iti asya aṣṭamasya api na mokṣaḥ usti atattva jña tvāt atha pañcamam pṛcchati kim jñātvā pravrajitaḥ asi iti sa pratyāha aham alabdha lābhāya anveṣṭum kṣamaḥ labdhvā rakṣāmi akṣayāya upabhujya punar ārjayitum ca kṣamaḥ yadi utkṛṣṭam icchāmi aham tat api labdhum kṣamaḥ tathā ced kutas pravrajitaḥ viṣaya arjana vṛtti catuṣṭayena anyaḥ hiṃsyate

original: yadi hiṃsako na [bhavāmi] iyaṃ vṛttirna siddhyati | kṛṣikṛtcet‌ vṛkṣān‌ chindyām‌ | yoddhā cet‌, tadā janān‌ hanyām‌ | yadi vānyadhanāpahartā | tadānyān‌ vadhyām‌ | yadi vā [vaṇik‌] svavācā mithyā brūyām‌ | iti sarve doṣā loke viṣayeṇa sahodyanti | ahametaddoṣaṃ jñātvā pravrajyāmicchāmi | asya navamasyāpi na bhavati mokṣaḥ |
analyzed: yadi hiṃsakaḥ na bhavāmi iyam vṛttiḥ na siddhyati kṛṣi kṛt ced vṛkṣān chindyām yoddhā ced tadā janān hanyām yadi vā anya dhana apahartā tadā anyān vadhyām yadi vā vaṇij sva vācā mithyā brūyām iti sarve doṣāḥ loke viṣayeṇa saha udyanti aham etat doṣam jñātvā pravrajyām icchāmi asya navamasya api na bhavati mokṣaḥ

original: bāhya[viṣayo]dvegāttattvajñānānabhyāsāt‌ | ata ucyate prathamamādhyātmikyaścatasraḥ tataḥ pañca bāhyā ityāhatya nava tuṣṭaya iti | āsāṃ navānāṃ tuṣṭīnāṃ maharṣiṇā nava nāmāni sthāpitāni | viṣayamalaśodhakatvāt‌ nava tuṣṭayaḥ salilākhyayā ucyante | ambhaḥ salilam‌ oghaḥ vṛṣṭiḥ tāram‌ sutāram‌ sunetram‌ sumarīcam‌ uttamāmbhasikamiti |
analyzed: bāhya viṣaya udvegāt tattva jñāna anabhyāsāt atas ucyate prathamam ādhyātmikyaḥ catasraḥ tatas pañca bāhyāḥ iti āhatya nava tuṣṭayaḥ iti āsām navānām tuṣṭīnām mahā ṛṣiṇā nava nāmāni sthāpitāni viṣaya mala śodhaka tvāt nava tuṣṭayaḥ salila ākhyayā ucyante ambhaḥ salilam oghaḥ vṛṣṭiḥ tāram sutāram sunetram sumarīcam uttamāmbhasikam iti

original: etannanavatuṣṭiviparītā navāśaktaya ākhyāyante yat‌ anambhaḥ yāvadanuttamāmbhasikamiti || 50 ||
analyzed: etad na nava tuṣṭi viparītāḥ navā āśaktayaḥ ākhyāyante yat anambhaḥ yāvat anuttamāmbhasikam iti

original: para āha | ime trayo dharmāḥ siddhyā saha viruddhāḥ | ko dharmaḥ siddhirityākhyāyate | āryayottaramāha |
analyzed: paraḥ āha ime trayaḥ dharmāḥ siddhyā saha viruddhāḥ kaḥ dharmaḥ siddhiḥ iti ākhyāyate āryayā uttaram āha

original: ūhaḥ śabdo'dhyayanaṃ duḥkhavighātatrayaṃ suhṛtprāptiḥ |
analyzed: ūhaḥ śabda udhyayanam duḥkha vighāta trayam suhṛd prāptiḥ

original: dānañca siddhayo'ṣṭau siddheḥ pūrvo'ṅkuśastrividhaḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: dānam ca siddhayāḥ ṣṭau siddheḥ pūrva uṅkuśaḥ trividhaḥ

original: ūhaḥ śravaṇamadhyayanaṃ.... dānanimittaṃ siddhayoṣṭāviti | ābhiraṣṭavidhaśaktibhiḥ ṣaḍgatayaḥ siddhyanti | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇaḥ pravrajitaḥ mārgamadhīyāna imāṃ cintāṃ karoti | kā vṛttiruttamā | kiṃ vastu satyam‌ | kimatyantaṃ pāryantikam‌ | kiṃ kṛtvā jñānaṃ bhavati | prakāśinīṃ siddhiñca labhate | ityevaṃ kṛtohaḥ jñānaṃ labhate |
analyzed: ūhaḥ śravaṇam adhyayanam dāna nimittam siddhayaḥ oṣṭau iti ābhiḥ aṣṭavidha śaktibhiḥ ṣaṣ gatayaḥ siddhi anti yathā kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajitaḥ mārgam adhīyānaḥ imām cintām karoti kā vṛttiḥ uttamā kim vastu satyam kim atyantam pāryantikam kim kṛtvā jñānam bhavati prakāśinīm siddhim ca labhate iti evam kṛta ūhaḥ jñānam labhate

original: pradhānaṃ bhinnaṃ buddhirbhinnā, ahaṅkāro bhinnaḥ, pañcatanmātrāṇi bhinnāni, ekādaśendriyāṇi bhinnāni, pañcamahābhūtāni bhinnāni, paramātmā bhinna [iti] | pañcamahābhūteṣu doṣamavalokayati | doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā udvega utpadyate | tadā pañcamahābhūtāni tyajati | [ida]mūhapadamākhyāyate | ekādaśendriyeṣu doṣamavalokayati | doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā udvega utpadyate |
analyzed: pradhānam bhinnam buddhiḥ bhinnā ahaṅkāraḥ bhinnaḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi bhinnāni ekādaśa indriyāṇi bhinnāni pañca mahābhūtāni bhinnāni paramātmā bhinnaḥ iti pañca mahābhūteṣu doṣam avalokayati doṣam dṛṣṭvā udvegaḥ utpadyate tadā pañca mahābhūtāni tyajati idam ūha padam ākhyāyate ekādaśa indriyeṣu doṣam avalokayati doṣam dṛṣṭvā udvegaḥ utpadyate

original: tadaikādaśendriyāṇi tyajati | idaṃ dhṛtipadamityākhyāyate | etajjñānaviniyogena pañcatanmātreṣu doṣamavalokayati | doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā udvega utpadyate | tadā tanmātrāṇi tyajati | [ida]mupagatasamapadamityākhyāyate | ahaṅkāre'ṣṭaiśvaryeṣu ca doṣamavalokayati | doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā udvega utpadyate | tadā ahaṅkārādīṃstyajati | [idaṃ] prāptipadamityākhyāyate |
analyzed: tadā ekādaśa indriyāṇi tyajati idam dhṛti padam iti ākhyāyate etat jñāna viniyogena pañca tanmātreṣu doṣam avalokayati doṣam dṛṣṭvā udvegaḥ utpadyate tadā tanmātrāṇi tyajati idam upagata sama padam iti ākhyāyate ahaṅkāra iṣṭa aiśvaryeṣu ca doṣam avalokayati doṣam dṛṣṭvā udvegaḥ utpadyate tadā ahaṅkāra ādīn tyajati idam prāpti padam iti ākhyāyate

original: buddhau doṣamavalokayati | doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā udvega utpadyate | buddhityāgaṃ labhate | [idaṃ] nivṛttipadamityākhyāyate | pradhāne doṣamavalokayati | doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā udvega utpadyate | tadā pradhānaṃ tyajati | etatkaivalyapadamityucyate | sa brāhmaṇo'nenohena mokṣaṃ labhate | iyaṃ siddhirūhena labdatvādūhasiddhirityākhyāyate | ūhasiddhiruktā |
analyzed: buddhau doṣam avalokayati doṣam dṛṣṭvā udvegaḥ utpadyate buddhi tyāgam labhate idam nivṛtti padam iti ākhyāyate pradhāne doṣam avalokayati doṣam dṛṣṭvā udvegaḥ utpadyate tadā pradhānam tyajati etat kaivalya padam iti ucyate sa brāhmaṇa ūnena ūhena mokṣam labhate iyam siddhiḥ ūhena labda tvāt ūha siddhiḥ iti ākhyāyate ūha siddhiḥ uktā

original: atha śravaṇasiddhiḥ kathyate | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇaḥ śabdamadhīyānamanyaṃ śṛṇoti | yatpradhānaṃ bhinnaṃ buddhirbhinnā yāvatparamātmā bhinna iti | imamadhyayanaśabdaṃ śṛṇvan‌ pañcaviṃśatipadārthān‌ buddhavān‌ | tadā ūhapadaṃ praviṣṭaḥ pañcabhūtāni tyajati | dhṛtipadaṃ praviṣṭa ekādaśendriyāṇi tyajati |
analyzed: atha śravaṇa siddhiḥ kathyate yathā kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ śabdam adhīyānam anyam śṛṇoti yat pradhānam bhinnam buddhiḥ bhinnā yāvat paramātmā bhinnaḥ iti imam adhyayana śabdam śṛṇvan pañcaviṃśati padārthān buddhavān tadā ūha padam praviṣṭaḥ pañcabhūtāni tyajati dhṛti padam praviṣṭaḥ ekādaśa indriyāṇi tyajati

original: upagatasamapadaṃ praviṣṭaḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi tyajati | prāptipadaṃ praviṣṭaḥ ahaṅkārādīṃstyajati | nivṛttipadaṃ praviṣṭo buddhiṃ tyajati | kaivalyapadaṃ praviṣṭaḥ pradhānaṃ tyajati | ayaṃ mokṣa ityākhyāyate | śravaṇasiddhiruktā | athādhyayanasiddhiḥ | aṣṭa buddhyaṅgāni siddhiprāpakāṇi santi | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇo gurukulaṃ gacchati |
analyzed: upagata sama padam praviṣṭaḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi tyajati prāpti padam praviṣṭaḥ ahaṅkāra ādīn tyajati nivṛtti padam praviṣṭaḥ buddhim tyajati kaivalya padam praviṣṭaḥ pradhānam tyajati ayam mokṣaḥ iti ākhyāyate śravaṇa siddhiḥ uktā atha adhyayana siddhiḥ aṣṭa buddhyaṅgāni siddhi prāpakāṇi santi yathā kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ guru kulam gacchati

original: prītyā śuśrūṣate | saśraddhaṃ tattvaṃ śṛṇoti | gṛhṇāti | smṛtvā dhārayati | padārthān‌ jānāti | ūhate | apohati | yathābhūtamabhiniviśate | imānyaṣṭa buddhyaṅgānītyucyante | ebhirbuddhyaṅgaiḥ pañcaviṃśatitattvānyupalabhate | ṣaḍgatīḥ praviśya mokṣaṃ labhate | [atha] duḥkhavighātatrayasiddhiḥ | ābhyantaraduḥkhavighātaḥ |
analyzed: prītyā śuśrūṣate sa śraddham tattvam śṛṇoti gṛhṇāti smṛtvā dhārayati padārthān jānāti ūhate apohati yathābhūtam abhiniviśate imāni aṣṭa buddhyaṅgāni iti ucyante ebhiḥ buddhyaṅgaiḥ pañcaviṃśati tattvāni upalabhate ṣaṣ gatīḥ praviśya mokṣam labhate atha duḥkha vighāta traya siddhiḥ ābhyantara duḥkha vighātaḥ

original: yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇa ābhyantaraduḥkhena śirovyādhyādinābhihato vaidyaṃ gatvā labdhavyādhyupaśamo [bhavati] | anenābhyantaraduḥkhena jijñāsā udeti | etadduḥkhanimittanirodhajñānānveṣaṇārthaṃ siddhagurukulaṃ vrajati | aṣṭasu buddhyaṅgeṣu pravartate | pañcaviṃśatitattvānyupalabhate | ṣaḍgatyavalokanapraveśānmokṣaṃ labhate |
analyzed: yathā kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ ābhyantara duḥkhena śiraḥ vyādhi ādinā abhihataḥ vaidyam gatvā labdha vyādhi upaśamaḥ bhavati anena ābhyantara duḥkhena jijñāsā udeti etad duḥkha nimitta nirodha jñāna anveṣaṇa artham siddha guru kulam vrajati aṣṭasu buddhyaṅgeṣu pravartate pañcaviṃśati tattvāni upalabhate ṣaṣ gati avalokana praveśāt mokṣam labhate

original: iyaṃ siddhirābhyantaraduḥkhena bhavati | yathā śārīraṃ duḥkham‌ | tathā mānasaṃ duḥkhamapi | bāhyaduḥkhavighātaḥ | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇo bāhyaduḥkhenābhihato bhavati | yaduta martyapaśupakṣiṇāṃ vṛkṣaśilādiparyantānāmabhighātaduḥkham‌ | [tat‌] kṣantumaśaknuvan‌ duḥkhanimittanirodhajijñāsāyāṃ pravartate | gurukulaṃ gacchati |
analyzed: iyam siddhiḥ ābhyantara duḥkhena bhavati yathā śārīram duḥkham tathā mānasam duḥkham api bāhya duḥkha vighātaḥ yathā kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ bāhya duḥkhena abhihataḥ bhavati yat uta martya paśu pakṣiṇām vṛkṣa śilā ādi paryantānām abhighāta duḥkham tat kṣantum aśaknuvan duḥkha nimitta nirodha jijñāsāyām pravartate guru kulam gacchati

original: aṣṭabuddhyaṅgānyabhyasyati | pañcaviṃśatitattvānyupalabhate | ṣaḍgatyavalokanapraveśānmokṣamāpnoti | iyaṃ siddhirbāhyaduḥkhena labhyate | ādhidaivikaduḥkha[vighātaḥ] | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇa ādhidaivikena duḥkhena śītātapavarṣādinābhihato bhavati | tatsoḍhumaśaknuvan‌ guruṃ vrajati | aṣṭabuddhyaṅgāni prārthayate | pañcaviṃśatitattvānyupalabhate |
analyzed: aṣṭa buddhyaṅgāni abhyasyati pañcaviṃśati tattvāni upalabhate ṣaṣ gati avalokana praveśāt mokṣam āpnoti iyam siddhiḥ bāhya duḥkhena labhyate ādhidaivika duḥkha vighātaḥ yathā kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ ādhidaivikena duḥkhena śīta ātapa varṣa ādinā abhihataḥ bhavati tat soḍhum aśaknuvan gurum vrajati aṣṭa buddhyaṅgāni prārthayate pañcaviṃśati tattvāni upalabhate

original: ṣaḍgatyavalokanāni praviśati | ato mokṣaṃ labhate | suhṛtprāptiriti | aṣṭabhirbuddhyaṅgairaprāptaṃ jñānaṃ kevalaṃ kalyāṇamitrātprāpnoti | prāpte pāryantike jñāne mokṣaṃ labhate | dānanimittasiddhiḥ | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇo janadviṣṭo jānātyanyaṃ dviṣantam‌ | tasmātpravrajati | pravrajitamācāryaḥ satīrthyā api dviṣanti | na jñānaṃ dadati |
analyzed: ṣaṣ gati avalokanāni praviśati atas mokṣam labhate suhṛd prāptiḥ iti aṣṭabhiḥ buddhyaṅgaiḥ aprāptam jñānam kevalam kalyāṇamitrāt prāpnoti prāpte pāryantike jñāne mokṣam labhate dāna nimitta siddhiḥ yathā kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ jana dviṣṭaḥ jānāti anyam dviṣantam tasmāt pravrajati pravrajitam ācāryaḥ sa tīrthyāḥ api dviṣanti na jñānam dadati

original: svayaṃ jñātvā [svā]lpabhāgyatāṃ grāmāntaṃ gacchati vastum‌ | svayañca vadati ayaṃ pradeśo brāhmaṇarahitaḥ | [atra] varṣāvāsaṃ vasāmīti | gatvoṣito bahu labhate bhikṣām‌ | sa śiṣṭaṃ suhṛdbhyo bandhubhyo gopālāṅganāparyantebhyaḥ pratyarpayati | asmin‌ grāme sarve'pi janā snigdhā bhavanti |
analyzed: svayam jñātvā sva alpabhāgya tām grāma antam gacchati vastum svayam ca vadati ayam pradeśaḥ brāhmaṇa rahitaḥ atra varṣa āvāsam vasāmi iti gatvā uṣitaḥ bahu labhate bhikṣām sa śiṣṭam suhṛdbhyaḥ bandhubhyaḥ gopāla aṅganā paryantebhyaḥ pratyarpayati asmin grāme sarve api janāḥ snigdhāḥ bhavanti

original: varṣāvāsaṃ parisamīpsorjanāḥ sarve'pi tridaṇḍamamatraṃ vastrāṇyanyāni ca dadati | [tataḥ] śakrotsavaḥ saṃnihitaḥ | tadā janān‌ dadati | ko mayā saha enamutsavaṃ draṣṭuṃ mama mahājanapadamāgamiṣyati | yadi jigamiṣatha, [yūyaṃ] sarve janā mahyaṃ yatkiñciddatvā gacchata iti | tatra gatvā gurukulaṃ prayāti |
analyzed: varṣa āvāsam parisamīpsoḥ janāḥ sarve api tridaṇḍam amatram vastrāṇi anyāni ca dadati tatas śakra utsavaḥ saṃnihitaḥ tadā janān dadati kaḥ mayā saha enam utsavam draṣṭum mama mahā janapadam āgamiṣyati yadi jigamiṣatha yūyam sarve janāḥ mahyam yat kiñcid datvā gacchataḥ iti tatra gatvā guru kulam prayāti

original: utkṛṣṭaṃ vastu samṛddhṛtyācāryaṃ satkaroti | avaśiṣṭāni krameṇa sahādhyāyibhyaḥ saṃvibhajati | ācāryaḥ suhṛjjanāḥ sarve'pi snigdhā bhavanti | tadā gururjñānaṃ dadāti | anena jñānena pāryantikaṃ jñānaṃ prāpnoti | tadā mokṣaṃ ca labhate | iyaṃ jñānalabdhā siddhiḥ | āsāmaṣṭasiddhīnāṃ prācīnairmaharṣibhirnāmāntarāṇi sthāpitāni |
analyzed: utkṛṣṭam vastu samṛddhṛtya ācāryam satkaroti avaśiṣṭāni krameṇa sahādhyāyibhyaḥ saṃvibhajati ācāryaḥ suhṛd janāḥ sarve api snigdhāḥ bhavanti tadā guruḥ jñānam dadāti anena jñānena pāryantikam jñānam prāpnoti tadā mokṣam ca labhate iyam jñāna labdhā siddhiḥ āsām aṣṭa siddhīnām prācīnaiḥ mahā ṛṣibhiḥ nāma antarāṇi sthāpitāni

original: svatārasiddhiḥ sutārasiddhiḥ tāratārasiddhiḥ pramodatārasiddhiḥ pramuditatārasiddhiḥ mohanatārasiddhiḥ ramyakatārasiddhiḥ sadāpramuditatārasiddhiḥ iti | āsāmaṣṭāsiddhināṃ viparītāścet‌, tadāśaktaya ākhyāyante yaduta atārāśaktiḥ yāvadasadāpramuditāśaktiḥ |
analyzed: sva tāra siddhiḥ su tāra siddhiḥ tāra tāra siddhiḥ pramoda tāra siddhiḥ pramudita tāra siddhiḥ mohana tāra siddhiḥ ramyaka tāra siddhiḥ sadāpramudita tāra siddhiḥ iti āsām aṣṭa asiddhinām viparītāḥ ced tadā aśaktayaḥ ākhyāyante yat uta a tāra aśaktiḥ yāvat asadāpramudita aśaktiḥ

original: evamekādaśendriyapātādiśaktayaḥ saptadaśabuddhivadhādaśaktayaśca aṣṭāviṃśatiraśaktayo bhavanti | ime viparyayāśaktituṣṭisiddhibhedāḥ pañcāśatpadārthā uktāḥ | pūrve trayaḥ siddheraṅkuśā iti | yathā matto gajo'ṅkuśaniyantrito na yathecchasvātantramāpnoti |
analyzed: evam ekādaśa indriya pāta ādi śaktayaḥ saptadaśa buddhi vadhāt aśaktayaḥ ca aṣṭāviṃśatiḥ aśaktayaḥ bhavanti ime viparyaya aśakti tuṣṭi siddhi bhedāḥ pañcāśat padārthāḥ uktāḥ pūrve trayaḥ siddheḥ aṅkuśāḥ iti yathā mattaḥ gaja uṅkuśa niyantritaḥ na yathā icchā svātantram āpnoti

original: evaṃ pañcaviparyayairaṣṭāviṃśatyaśaktibhirnavatuṣṭibhirniyantrito loko na tattvajñānamadhigacchati | yadi tattvajñānaṃ jahāti tadāṣṭa siddhayo na bhavanti | ata uktaṃ pūrve trayaḥ siddheraṅkuśā iti | ataḥ viparyayāśaktituṣṭīstyaktā aṣṭavidhasiddhīryantenābhyasyet‌ || 51 ||
analyzed: evam pañca viparyayaiḥ aṣṭāviṃśati aśaktibhiḥ nava tuṣṭibhiḥ niyantritaḥ lokaḥ na tattva jñānam adhigacchati yadi tattva jñānam jahāti tadā aṣṭa siddhayaḥ na bhavanti atas uktam pūrve trayaḥ siddheḥ aṅkuśāḥ iti atas viparyaya aśakti tuṣṭīḥ tyaktāḥ aṣṭavidha siddhīḥ yantena abhyasyet 51

original: para āha bhāvairadhivāsitaṃ liṅgam‌ | ataḥ saṃsarati saṃsāre iti pūrvamuktam‌ | liṅgaṃ dvividham‌ | sūkṣmaṃ liṅgam‌, ādāvutpannam‌ | mātāpitṛjaṃ śarīramekādaśendriyāṇi ca | ubhayaṃ saṃyuktamaṣṭabhirbhāvairadhivāsitam‌, ataḥ saṃsarati saṃsāre | atra saṃśayaṃ kiṃ pūrvamutpadyate | kiṃ liṅgaṃ pūrvam‌, kiṃ vā bhāvāḥ pūrvamiti | āryayottaramāha |
analyzed: paraḥ āha bhāvaiḥ adhivāsitam liṅgam atas saṃsarati saṃsāre iti pūrvam uktam liṅgam dvividham sūkṣmam liṅgam ādau utpannam mātā pitṛ jam śarīram ekādaśa indriyāṇi ca ubhayam saṃyuktam aṣṭabhiḥ bhāvaiḥ adhivāsitam atas saṃsarati saṃsāre atra saṃśayam kim pūrvam utpadyate kim liṅgam pūrvam kim vā bhāvāḥ pūrvam iti āryayā uttaram āha

original: na vinā bhāvairliṅgaṃ na vinā liṅgena bhāvanirvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: na vinā bhāvaiḥ liṅgam na vinā liṅgena bhāva nirvṛttiḥ

original: liṅgākhyo bhāvākhyastasmādbhavati dvidhā sargaḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: liṅga ākhyaḥ bhāva ākhyaḥ tasmāt bhavati dvidhā sargaḥ 52

original: vinā bhāvairna vibhaktaṃ liṅgamiti | yadi bhāvā na santi | liṅgaṃ na siddhyet‌ | yathauṣṇyaṃ vinā nāgniḥ siddhyati | vinā sūkṣmaliṅgena na bhāvā iti | bhāvā liṅgavirahitāścet‌, na siddhyanti | yathāgniṃ vinā auṣṇyaṃ na siddhyati | imāvubhau dharmau parasparāpekṣau analauṣṇyavat‌ | tau ca dharmau yugapadudbhavataḥ yathā goḥ śṛṅgadvayam‌ |
analyzed: vinā bhāvaiḥ na vibhaktam liṅgam iti yadi bhāvāḥ na santi liṅgam na siddhyet yathā auṣṇyam vinā na agniḥ siddhi ati vinā sūkṣma liṅgena na bhāvāḥ iti bhāvāḥ liṅga virahitāḥ ced na siddhī anti yathā agnim vinā auṣṇyam na siddhi ati imau ubhau dharmau paraspara apekṣau anala auṣṇya vat tau ca dharmau yugapad udbhavataḥ yathā goḥ śṛṅga dvayam

original: liṅgākhyo bhāvākhyastasmātsargo dvividha iti | prakṛtivikārasya dve ākhye staḥ | liṅgākhyaḥ sargaḥ bhāvākhyaḥ sarga iti | saṃsārasya sargādāveva dvaividhyaṃ saṃpannam‌ || para āha | asya sarasya kiṃ dvaividhyamevāsti kiṃ vā punarastyanyākhyaḥ [sarga] iti | samādhīyate ||
analyzed: liṅga ākhyaḥ bhāva ākhyaḥ tasmāt sargaḥ dvividhaḥ iti prakṛti vikārasya dve ākhye staḥ liṅga ākhyaḥ sargaḥ bhāva ākhyaḥ sargaḥ iti saṃsārasya sarga ādau eva dvaividhyam saṃpannam paraḥ āha asya sarasya kim dvaividhyam eva asti kim vā punar asti anya ākhyaḥ sargaḥ iti samādhīyate

original: prācīnamaharṣibhirnāmāntarāṇi sthāpitāni | svatāramiti | ayaṃ puruṣo'timātraṃ svohatīkṣṇaḥ kevalaṃ prajñāṃ labdhvā mokṣaṃ sādhayati | na paropadeśena | ato vadanti svatārasiddhiriti | svohamātreṇa labdhvā na pareṇa iti svatāram‌ | saiva prajñā | prajñā hi aihikānmocayitvā āmuṣmikaṃ prāpayati | ataḥ parākrāntakāla iti vyapadiśanti |
analyzed: prācīna mahā ṛṣibhiḥ nāma antarāṇi sthāpitāni sva tāram iti ayam puruṣaḥ ūti mātram sva ūha tīkṣṇaḥ kevalam prajñām labdhvā mokṣam sādhayati na para upadeśena atas vadanti sva tāra siddhiḥ iti sva ūha mātreṇa labdhvā na pareṇa iti sva tāram sā eva prajñā prajñā hi aihikāt mocayitvā āmuṣmikam prāpayati atas parākrānta kālaḥ iti vyapadiśanti

original: tadā hi mokṣo nāma | mokṣa eva siddhirityākhyāyate | hetustāramucyate | phalaṃ siddhirucyate | imāṃ tārasiddhiṃ svohena labdhatvāt‌ svatārasiddhiriti vadanti | paścātsapta tārasiddhaya abhinnā nāmāntaramātreṇa viṣamāḥ | sutārasiddhiriti | ātmanā pareṇa [ca] labdhaprajño mokṣaṃ sādhayati |
analyzed: tadā hi mokṣaḥ nāma mokṣaḥ eva siddhiḥ iti ākhyāyate hetuḥ tāram ucyate phalam siddhiḥ ucyate imām tāra siddhim svohena labdha tvāt sva tāra siddhiḥ iti vadanti paścāt sapta tāra siddhayaḥ abhinnāḥ nāma antara mātreṇa viṣamāḥ su tāra siddhiḥ iti ātmanā pareṇa ca labdha prajñaḥ mokṣam sādhayati

original: ayaṃ puruṣaḥ samṛddhendriyaḥ kiñcidavaraḥ paropadeśena [labdha]bahusvārtho mokṣamāptuṃ śaknoti | ataḥ sutārasiddhiriti vyapadiśanti | tāratārasiddhiriti | ekāntataḥ paropadeśena labdhatvāttāreti | [ayaṃ] samṛddhendriyaḥ tato'pi avaraḥ | pramodatārasiddhiriti | ayaṃ puruṣa ābhyantaraduḥkhena śirovyādhyādinābhihato guruṃ vrajati |
analyzed: ayam puruṣaḥ samṛddha indriyaḥ kiñcid avaraḥ para upadeśena labdha bahu svārthaḥ mokṣam āptum śaknoti atas su tāra siddhiḥ iti vyapadiśanti tāra tāra siddhiḥ iti ekāntataḥ para upadeśena labdha tvāt tāra iti ayam samṛddha indriyaḥ tatas api avaraḥ pramoda tāra siddhiḥ iti ayam puruṣaḥ ābhyantara duḥkhena śiraḥ vyādhi ādinā abhihataḥ gurum vrajati

original: cikitsāṃ prārthayate | tātkālikīmābhyantaraduḥkhanivṛttiṃ labhate | iyamekavidhapramodāya bhavati | [atha] cintayati | idaṃ nivṛttimātraṃ, nātyantikanivṛttiriti | yadā kaivalyaṃ, tadā tu ātyantikanivṛttiriti jñānāt‌ sāṃkhyācāryaṃ vrajati | prajñāṃ śikṣate | mokṣasiddhiṃ prārthayate | paramaṃ pramodamāpnoti |
analyzed: cikitsām prārthayate tātkālikīm ābhyantara duḥkha nivṛttim labhate iyam ekavidha pramodāya bhavati atha cintayati idam nivṛtti mātram na ātyantika nivṛttiḥ iti yadā kaivalyam tadā tu ātyantika nivṛttiḥ iti jñānāt sāṃkhya ācāryam vrajati prajñām śikṣate mokṣa siddhim prārthayate paramam pramodam āpnoti

original: asmādubhayavidhapramoda[lābhā]t‌ pramodatārasiddhirityākhyā bhavati | pramuditatārasiddhiriti | ayaṃ puruṣa ābhyantarabāhyobhayavidhaduḥkhābhihataḥ [cikitsā]cāryaṃ gatvā duḥkhadvayasya cikitsāṃ prārthayate | yato duḥkhadvayasya tātkālikī śāntiḥ tadaivobhayavidhapramodo bhavati |
analyzed: asmāt ubhayavidha pramoda lābhāt pramoda tāra siddhiḥ iti ākhyā bhavati pramudita tāra siddhiḥ iti ayam puruṣaḥ ābhyantara bāhya ubhayavidha duḥkha abhihataḥ cikitsā ācāryam gatvā duḥkha dvayasya cikitsām prārthayate yatas duḥkha dvayasya tātkālikī śāntiḥ tadā eva ubhayavidha pramodaḥ bhavati

original: neyamātyantikī nivṛttiriti jñātvā tārasiddhiṃ śikṣitumācāryaṃ prārthayate | [siddhi]lābhātpramodaḥ pramuditākhyāmupādatte | mohana[tārasiddhi]riti | ayaṃ puruṣaḥ ābhyantaraduḥkhaṃ śirovyādhyādi | bāhyaduḥkhamasigadādi daivaduḥkhaṃ vātavarṣaśītātapādi | etatsarvaduḥkhatrayābhibhūtaḥ ācāryaṃ gatvā cikitsāṃ prārthayate | taccikitsā yato viśiṣyate |
analyzed: na iyam ātyantikī nivṛttiḥ iti jñātvā tāra siddhim śikṣitum ācāryam prārthayate siddhi lābhāt pramodaḥ pramudita ākhyām upādatte mohana tāra siddhiḥ iti ayam puruṣaḥ ābhyantara duḥkham śiraḥ vyādhi ādi bāhya duḥkham asi gada ādi daiva duḥkham vāta varṣa śīta ātapa ādi etad sarva duḥkha traya abhibhūtaḥ ācāryam gatvā cikitsām prārthayate tat cikitsā yatas viśiṣyate

original: [tato] mohanamiti vyapadiśyate | [iyaṃ] nātyantikanivṛttiriti jñātvā ācāryamupagamya śikṣābhyāsāttārasiddhiṃ labhate | asmānmohanatārasiddhirityākhyā bhavati | ramyakatārasiddhiriti | [ayaṃ puruṣa] ācāryānukampāprītibhyāṃ tāṃ tārasiddhiṃ śikṣate | ācāryāttāmākhyāmupādatte | sadāpramuditasiddhiriti |
analyzed: tatas mohanam iti vyapadiśyate iyam na ātyantika nivṛttiḥ iti jñātvā ācāryam upagamya śikṣā abhyāsāt tāra siddhim labhate asmāt mohana tāra siddhiḥ iti ākhyā bhavati ramyaka tāra siddhiḥ iti ayam puruṣaḥ ācārya anukampā prītibhyām tām tāra siddhim śikṣate ācāryāt tām ākhyām upādatte sadā pramudita siddhiḥ iti

original: ayaṃ puruṣaḥ sarvadviṣṭo dhanavastradānaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | [tāni] datvā sarveṣāṃ snigdho bhavati | sarve'pi tasya siddhiṃ kartumabhilaṣanti | ataḥ sadāpramuditatārasiddhiriti vadanti || indriyavadhādaśaktaya ekādaśa buddhivaśādaśaktayaḥ saptadaśa cāhatyāśaktayo'ṣṭāviṃśatiḥ |
analyzed: ayam puruṣaḥ sarva dviṣṭaḥ dhana vastra dānam pratigṛhṇāti tāni da tvā sarveṣām snigdhaḥ bhavati sarve api tasya siddhim kartum abhilaṣanti atas sadā pramudita tāra siddhiḥ iti vadanti indriya vadhāt aśaktayaḥ ekādaśa buddhi vaśāt aśaktayaḥ saptadaśa ca āhatya aśaktayaḥ ṣṭāviṃśatiḥ

original: pañcaviparyayairnavatuṣṭibhiraṣṭasiddhibhiḥ saha pañcāśadantata uktā iti siddham‌ || pūrve trayaḥ siddheraṅkuśā iti pañcaviparyayā aṣṭāviṃśatyaśaktayo navatuṣṭayaśca | ime [pūrve] antimāṣṭasiddhigajasyāṅkuśāḥ | aṣṭavidhāḥ [siddhayaḥ] mokṣaṃ sādhayitumarhanti | trividhā[ṅkuśena] tu na śaknuvanti |
analyzed: pañca viparyayaiḥ navatuṣṭibhiḥ aṣṭa siddhibhiḥ saha pañcāśat antataḥ uktāḥ iti siddham pūrve trayaḥ siddheḥ aṅkuśāḥ iti pañca viparyayāḥ aṣṭāviṃśati aśaktayaḥ nava tuṣṭayaḥ ca ime pūrve antima aṣṭa siddhi gajasya aṅkuśāḥ aṣṭavidhāḥ siddhayaḥ mokṣam sādhayitum arhanti trividha aṅkuśena tu na śaknuvanti

original: yathā mattagajaḥ svātantrārho'ṅkuśena na yathecchaṃ svātantryaṃ prayāti | tathāṣṭasiddhayo'pi | avaśyaṃ tattvajñānenāṣṭasiddhayo labhyante | trividhāṅkuśena tattvajñānaṃ na labhyate | ato'vaśyaṃ pūrvaṃ trividhaṃ tyaktvā antimāṣṭasiddhīryatnenābhyaset‌ |
analyzed: yathā matta gajaḥ svātantrā arha uṅkuśena na yatheccham svātantryam prayāti tathā aṣṭa siddhayaḥ api avaśyam tattva jñānena aṣṭa siddhayaḥ labhyante trividha aṅkuśena tattva jñānam na labhyate atas vaśyam pūrvam trividham tyaktvā antima aṣṭa siddhīḥ yatnena abhyaset

original: para āha | atha prathamaṃ pūrvapadārthaṃ paścāt‌ paurvāparyaṃ pṛcchāmi | bhāvairadhivāsitaṃ liṅgam‌, ataḥ saṃsarati saṃsāre iti purastāduktam‌ | bhāvā aṣṭāveva yaduta catvāro dharmāścatvāro'dharmāḥ | catvāro dharmā dharmaḥ jñānam‌ virāgaḥ aiśvaryañceti | eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ viparītā eva catvāro'dharmāḥ | [ime]'ṣṭau bhāvā ityākhyāyante |
analyzed: paraḥ āha atha prathamam pūrva padārtham paścāt paurvāparyam pṛcchāmi bhāvaiḥ adhivāsitam liṅgam atas saṃsarati saṃsāre iti purastāt uktam bhāvāḥ aṣṭau eva yat uta catvāraḥ dharmāḥ catvāraḥ dharmāḥ catvāraḥ dharmāḥ dharmaḥ jñānam virāgaḥ aiśvaryam ca iti eṣām caturṇām dharmāṇām viparītāḥ eva catvāraḥ dharmāḥ ime ṣṭau bhāvāḥ iti ākhyāyante

original: pūrvaiścaturbhiḥ dharmairadhivāsitaṃ devagatiṃ prāpnoti | antimaiścaturbhiradharmairadhivāsitaṃ martyapaśugatidvayaṃ prāpnoti | adhivāsitaṃ liṅga[mityatra] liṅgaṃ dvividham‌ | pradhānabuddhyahaṅkārapañcatanmātrāṇi sūkṣmaliṅgamityākhyāyante | pañcatanmātrebhya utpannamekādaśendriyasaṃyuktaṃ sat‌ uddhitaṃ sthūlaliṅgamityākhyāyate |
analyzed: pūrvaiḥ caturbhiḥ dharmaiḥ adhivāsitam deva gatim prāpnoti antimaiḥ caturbhiḥ adharmaiḥ adhivāsitam martya paśu gati dvayam prāpnoti adhivāsitam liṅgam iti atra liṅgam dvividham pradhāna buddhi ahaṅkāra pañca tanmātrāṇi sūkṣma liṅgam iti ākhyāyante pañca tanmātrebhyaḥ utpannam ekādaśa indriya saṃyuktam sat uddhitam sthūla liṅgam iti ākhyāyate

original: eṣāmaṣṭavidhabhāvānāmadhivāsitaliṅgadvayasya ca kiṃ pūrvamutpadyate | kimaṣṭabhāvāḥ kiṃ pūrvaṃ kiṃ vā liṅgadvayaṃ pūrvamiti | samādhīyate | [atra] dve vyākhyāne staḥ | aṣṭabhāvānāṃ liṅgasya ca nāsti pūrvāparabhāvaḥ | avaśyaṃ saṃyuktāni yugapadutpadyante | yathāgnauṣṇye na viyogaṃ labhete | yathā vā goḥ śṛṅge dve'vaśyaṃ yugapatprādurbhavataḥ |
analyzed: eṣām aṣṭavidha bhāvānām adhivāsita liṅga dvayasya ca kim pūrvam utpadyate kim aṣṭa bhāvāḥ kim pūrvam kim vā liṅga dvayam pūrvam iti samādhīyate atra dve vyākhyāne staḥ aṣṭa bhāvānām liṅgasya ca na asti pūrva apara bhāvaḥ avaśyam saṃyuktāni yugapad utpadyante yathā agni auṣṇye na viyogam labhete yathā vā goḥ śṛṅge dve ivaśyam yugapad prādurbhavataḥ

original: tathā'ṣṭa bhāvā liṅgañca | yadā pradhānabuddhyahaṅkārapañcatanmātra[rūpa]sūkṣmaliṅgamasti | tadāvaśyamaṣṭasu bhāveṣu caturvidhāḥ santi | yadi na santi catvāro dharmāḥ tadā catvāro['dharmāḥ] santi | iti dharmādharmāḥ [sūkṣmaliṅgāt‌] niyamena na viyogaṃ labhante | tathā mātāpitṛjātaṃ sthūlaśarīramapi |
analyzed: tathā aṣṭa bhāvāḥ liṅgam ca yadā pradhāna buddhi ahaṅkāra pañca tanmātra rūpa sūkṣma liṅgam asti tadā avaśyam aṣṭasu bhāveṣu caturvidhāḥ santi yadi na santi catvāraḥ dharmāḥ tadā catvāraḥ dharmāḥ santi iti dharma adharmāḥ sūkṣma liṅgāt niyamena na viyogam labhante tathā mātā pitṛ jātam sthūlaśarīram api

original: evaṃ liṅgaśarīramapi aṣṭabhāvena niyamena na viyogaṃ labhate ||
analyzed: evam liṅga śarīram api aṣṭa bhāvena niyamena na viyogam labhate

original: asti bhautikākhyastṛtīyaḥ sargaḥ | yathāhāryā |
analyzed: asti bhautika ākhyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ sargaḥ yathā āhāryā

original: aṣṭavikalpo daivastairyagyonaśca pañcadhā bhavati |
analyzed: aṣṭa vikalpaḥ daivaḥ tairyagyonaḥ ca pañcadhā bhavati

original: mānuṣyakaścaikavidhaḥ samāsato bhautikaḥ sargaḥ || 53 ||
analyzed: mānuṣyakaḥ ca ekavidhaḥ samāsatas bhautikaḥ sargaḥ

original: daivagatiraṣṭavikalpeti | brāhmaḥ sargaḥ prājāpatyaḥ sarga aindraḥ sargaḥ gāndharvaḥ sargaḥ āsuraḥ sargaḥ yākṣaḥ sargaḥ rākṣasaḥ sargaḥ paiśācaḥ sargaḥ iti | tairyaggatiḥ pañcavikalpeti | cātuṣpādaḥ sargaḥ pātagaḥ sargaḥ auragaḥ sargaḥ tairyañcaḥ sargaḥ sthāvaraḥ sarga iti | mānuṣyakagatirekasarga eveti | manuṣyagaterekajātimātratvāt‌ |
analyzed: daiva gatiḥ aṣṭa vikalpā iti brāhmaḥ sargaḥ prājāpatyaḥ sargaḥ aindraḥ sargaḥ gāndharvaḥ sargaḥ āsuraḥ sargaḥ yākṣaḥ sargaḥ rākṣasaḥ sargaḥ paiśācaḥ sargaḥ iti tairyaggatiḥ pañca vikalpā iti cātuṣpādaḥ sargaḥ pātagaḥ sargaḥ auragaḥ sargaḥ tairyañcaḥ sargaḥ sthāvaraḥ sargaḥ iti mānuṣyaka gatiḥ eka sargaḥ eva iti manuṣya gateḥ eka jāti mātra tvāt

original: bhautikastrividha ukto yaduta devatiryaṅmanuṣyatrayaliṅgabhāvāstraya iti || 53 ||
analyzed: bhautikaḥ trividhaḥ uktaḥ yat uta deva tiryak manuṣya traya liṅga bhāvāḥ trayaḥ iti

original: para āha | triṣu lokeṣu kutra kimutkaṭamupalabhyate | āryayottaramāha |
analyzed: paraḥ āha triṣu lokeṣu kutra kim utkaṭam upalabhyate āryayā uttaram āha

original: ūrdhvaṃ sattvaviśālastamoviśālaśca mūlataḥ sargaḥ |
analyzed: ūrdhvam sattva viśālaḥ tamaḥ viśālaḥ ca mūlatas sargaḥ

original: madhye rajoviśālo brahmādistambaparyantaḥ || 54 ||
analyzed: madhye rajaḥ viśālaḥ brahma ādi stamba paryantaḥ

original: ūrdhvaṃ sattvaviśāla iti | brāhmasargasthānādau sattvamativiśālam‌ | atrāpi rajastamasī staḥ sattvenābhibhūte | ato brahmādayo devā bahvānandamanubhavanti | mūlataḥ sargastamoviśāla iti | yat‌ tiryakpakṣistambādisthāvarasargaparyantaḥ | atra tamo viśālam‌ | atrāpi rajassattve staḥ tamasābhibhūte | atastiryagādayo mohabahulāḥ | mūlataḥ sarga iti |
analyzed: ūrdhvam sattva viśāle iti brāhma sarga sthāna ādau sattvam ati viśālam atra api rajaḥ tamasī staḥ sattvena abhibhūte atas brahma ādayaḥ devāḥ bahu ānandam anubhavanti mūlatas sargaḥ tamaḥ viśālaḥ iti yat tiryak pakṣi stamba ādi sthāvara sarga paryantaḥ atra tamaḥ viśālam atra api rajaḥ sattve staḥ tamasā abhibhūte atas tiryak ādayaḥ moha bahulāḥ mūlatas sargaḥ iti

original: triṣu sargeṣu teṣāṃ [tiryagādīnāṃ] atyantamadhamatvānmūlata ityuktam‌ | madhyasargo rajoviśāla iti | mānuṣasarge rajo viśālam‌ | sattvatamasī api staḥ | rajobahulatvādabhibhūtasattvatamaskatvācca manuṣyeṣu śokaduḥkhe bahule | manuṣyagatermadhyeti nāma | tisṛṣu gatiṣu madhyavartitvāt‌ | antimaḥ sargaḥ kathaṃ stamba ityucyate |
analyzed: triṣu sargeṣu teṣām tiryak ādīnām atyantam adhama tvāt mūlataḥ iti uktam madhya sargaḥ rajaḥ viśālaḥ iti mānuṣa sarge rajaḥ viśālam sattva tamasī api staḥ rajaḥ bahula tvāt abhibhūta sattva tamaska tvāt ca manuṣyeṣu śoka duḥkhe bahule manuṣya gateḥ madhyā iti nāma tisṛṣu gatiṣu madhya varti tvāt antimaḥ sargaḥ katham stambaḥ iti ucyate

original: yadoṣadhivanaspatiparvatapāṣāṇādayaḥ, ebhistrayāṇāṃ lokānāmavaṣṭabdhatvāt‌ stambanāmā ucyate | evaṃ liṅgasargaḥ bhāvasargo bhautikasargaśca sarvathoktaḥ | trividho'yaṃ sargaḥ pradhānakṛta ityataḥ pradhānakāryamavasitam‌ | yaduta lokaṃ sṛṣṭvā mokṣaṃ prāpnotīti || 54 ||
analyzed: yat oṣadhi vanaspati parvata pāṣāṇa ādayaḥ ebhiḥ trayāṇām lokānām avaṣṭabdha tvāt stamba nāmā ucyate evam liṅga sargaḥ bhāva sargaḥ bhautika sargaḥ ca sarvathā uktaḥ trividhaḥ yam sargaḥ pradhāna kṛtaḥ iti atas pradhāna kāryam avasitam yat uta lokam sṛṣṭvā mokṣam prāpnoti iti

original: para āha | triṣu lokeṣu manuṣyadevatiryakṣu kaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhañcānubhavati | kiṃ pradhānamanubhavati kiṃ vā buddhyahaṅkārapañcatanmātrāṇi yāvadekādaśendriyāṇi anubhavanti kiṃ vāyaṃ puruṣo'nubhavati | āryayottaramāha |
analyzed: paraḥ āha triṣu lokeṣu manuṣya deva tiryakṣu kaḥ sukham duḥkham ca anubhavati kim pradhānam anubhavati kim vā buddhi ahaṅkāra pañca tanmātrāṇi yāvat ekādaśa indriyāṇi anubhavanti kim vā ayam puruṣaḥ anubhavati āryayā uttaram āha

original: atra jarāmaraṇakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpnoti cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ |
analyzed: atra jarā maraṇa kṛtam duḥkham prāpnoti cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ

original: liṅasyāvinivṛttestasmād‌ duḥkhaṃ samāsena || 55 ||
analyzed: liṅasya avinivṛtteḥ tasmāt duḥkham samāsena

original: atra jarāmaraṇaduḥkhaṃ kevalaṃ cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ prāpnotīti | triṣu lokeṣu duḥkhamasti jarākṛtam‌ | valitatvak‌, palitaṃ, śvāsamokaḥ, yaṣṭyavalambanaṃ, bandhumitrairlaghvīkaraṇam‌, evamādiduḥkhāni sarvāṇi jarānimittāni | maraṇaduḥkhamiti | [yathā] kaścitpuruṣaḥ labdhaiṣṭaiśvaryo yadi vā pañcasūkṣmaviṣayānupalabhate |
analyzed: atra jarā maraṇa duḥkham kevalam cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ prāpnoti iti triṣu lokeṣu duḥkham asti jarā kṛtam valita tvac palitam śvāsa mokaḥ yaṣṭi avalambanam bandhu mitraiḥ laghvīkaraṇam evamādi duḥkhāni sarvāṇi jarā nimittāni maraṇa duḥkham iti yathā kaścid puruṣaḥ labdha aiṣṭa aiśvaryaḥ yadi vā pañca sūkṣma viṣayān upalabhate

original: yadi vā sthūlaviṣayānupalabhate | sa maraṇamupagato yamena gṛhyate | atra maraṇaduḥkhākhyaṃ duḥkhamanubhavati | kiñca santi trīṇi duḥkhānyavāntarakālīnāni | imāni duḥkhāni cetanaḥ puruṣo'nubhavati | pradhānaṃ sthūlaśarīrañca nānubhavataḥ | acetanatvāt‌ | ata uktaṃ puruṣasya duḥkhaṃ, na pradhānādīnāmiti | para āha |
analyzed: yadi vā sthūla viṣayān upalabhate sa maraṇam upagataḥ yamena gṛhyate atra maraṇa duḥkha ākhyam duḥkham anubhavati kiñca santi trīṇi duḥkhāni avāntara kālīnāni imāni duḥkhāni cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ anubhavati pradhānam sthūlaśarīram ca na anubhavataḥ acetana tvāt atas uktam puruṣasya duḥkham na pradhāna ādīnām iti paraḥ āha

original: kiyatkālaṃ puruṣa imāni duḥkhānyanubhavati | uttaramāha | liṅgasyāvinivṛttau tasmātsamāsenoktamidaṃ duḥkhamiti | [yadā] mahadādiliṅgaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraduḥkhaṃ na nivartate | idaṃ sthūlaśarīraṃ loke saṃsarati na nivartate | etādṛśakālamadhye puruṣo duḥkhamanubhavati | yadā sūkṣmasthūlaliṅgaṃ nivartate | tadā puruṣo mucyate | yadā mucyate |
analyzed: kiyatkālam puruṣaḥ imāni duḥkhāni anubhavati uttaram āha liṅgasya avinivṛttau tasmāt samāsena uktam idam duḥkham iti yadā mahat ādi liṅgam sūkṣmaśarīra duḥkham na nivartate idam sthūlaśarīram loke saṃsarati na nivartate etādṛśa kāla madhye puruṣaḥ duḥkham anubhavati yadā sūkṣma sthūla liṅgam nivartate tadā puruṣaḥ mucyate yadā mucyate

original: tadā etādṛśaduḥkhāni nāntato'nubhavati | yadā na nivartate sūkṣmasthūlaliṅgam‌ | tadā na duḥkhānmokṣamāpnoti [puruṣaḥ] | tasmātsamāsenoktaṃ sūkṣmaliṅgaṃ sthūlaliṅgañca duḥkhamiti || 55 ||
analyzed: tadā etādṛśa duḥkhāni na antatas nubhavati yadā na nivartate sūkṣma sthūla liṅgam tadā na duḥkhāt mokṣam āpnoti puruṣaḥ tasmāt samāsena uktam sūkṣma liṅgam sthūla liṅgam ca duḥkham iti
